    &&& \multicolumn{2}{@{}l@{}}{\quad
    \quad
    \begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}}
    \mbox{if}~ z{.}\mathsf{exns}{}[a]{.}\mathsf{tag} = z{.}\mathsf{module}{.}\mathsf{tags}{}[x] \\
    {\land}~ {{\mathit{val}}^\ast} = z{.}\mathsf{exns}{}[a]{.}\mathsf{fields} \\
    \end{array}
    } \\[0.8ex]
    & z ; ({{\mathsf{handler}}_{n}}{\{ (\mathsf{catch\_all}~l)~{{\mathit{catch}'}^\ast} \}}~(\mathsf{ref{.}exn}~a)~\mathsf{throw\_ref}) & \hookrightarrow & (\mathsf{br}~l) \\[0.8ex]
    & z ; ({{\mathsf{handler}}_{n}}{\{ (\mathsf{catch\_all\_ref}~l)~{{\mathit{catch}'}^\ast} \}}~(\mathsf{ref{.}exn}~a)~\mathsf{throw\_ref}) & \hookrightarrow & (\mathsf{ref{.}exn}~a)~(\mathsf{br}~l) \\[0.8ex]
    & z ; ({{\mathsf{handler}}_{n}}{\{ {\mathit{catch}}~{{\mathit{catch}'}^\ast} \}}~(\mathsf{ref{.}exn}~a)~\mathsf{throw\_ref}) & \hookrightarrow & ({{\mathsf{handler}}_{n}}{\{ {{\mathit{catch}'}^\ast} \}}~(\mathsf{ref{.}exn}~a)~\mathsf{throw\_ref}) &  \\
    &&& \multicolumn{2}{@{}l@{}}{\quad
    \quad \mbox{otherwise}
    } \\
    \end{array}\end{split}

### `\mathsf{try\_table}~{\mathit{bt}}~{{\mathit{catch}}^\ast}~{{\mathit{instr}}^\ast}`

1.  Let `z` be the current state.

2.  Let `{t_1^{m}}~{\mathrel{\rightarrow}}_{{{\mathit{localidx}}_0^\ast}}\,{t_2^{n}}` be the destructuring of `{{\mathrm{instrtype}}}_{z}({\mathit{bt}})`.

3.  Assert: Due to validation, `{{\mathit{localidx}}_0^\ast} = \epsilon`.

4.  Assert: Due to validation, there are at least `m` values on the top of the stack.

5.  Pop the values `{{\mathit{val}}^{m}}` from the stack.

6.  Let `H` be the `\mathsf{handler}` whose arity is `n` and whose catch handler is `{{\mathit{catch}}^\ast}`.

7.  Push the `\mathsf{handler}` `H`.

8.  Let `L` be the `\mathsf{label}` whose arity is `n` and whose continuation is the end of the block.

9.  Enter the block `{{\mathit{val}}^{m}}~{{\mathit{instr}}^\ast}` with the `\mathsf{label}` `L`.

    \begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}}
    & z ; {{\mathit{val}}^{m}}~(\mathsf{try\_table}~{\mathit{bt}}~{{\mathit{catch}}^\ast}~{{\mathit{instr}}^\ast}) & \hookrightarrow & ({{\mathsf{handler}}_{n}}{\{ {{\mathit{catch}}^\ast} \}}~({{\mathsf{label}}_{n}}{\{ \epsilon \}}~{{\mathit{val}}^{m}}~{{\mathit{instr}}^\ast})) &  \\
    &&& \multicolumn{2}{@{}l@{}}{\quad
    \quad \mbox{if}~ {{\mathrm{instrtype}}}_{z}({\mathit{bt}}) = {t_1^{m}} \rightarrow {t_2^{n}}
    } \\
    \end{array}\end{split}

## Blocks

The following auxiliary rules define the semantics of executing an instruction sequence that forms a block.

### Entering `\mathit{instr}^\ast` with label `L` and values `\mathit{val}^\ast`

1.  Push `L` to the stack.

2.  Push the values `\mathit{val}^\ast` to the stack.

3.  Jump to the start of the instruction sequence `\mathit{instr}^\ast`.

Note

No formal reduction rule is needed for entering an instruction sequence, because the label `L` is embedded in the administrative instruction that structured control instructions reduce to directly.

### Exiting `\mathit{instr}^\ast` with label `L`

When the end of a block is reached without a jump, exception, or trap aborting it, then the following steps are performed.

1.  Pop all values `\mathit{val}^\ast` from the top of the stack.

2.  Assert: due to validation, the label `L` is now on the top of the stack.

3.  Pop the label from the stack.

4.  Push `\mathit{val}^\ast` back to the stack.

5.  Jump to the position after the end of the structured control instruction associated with the label `L`.

    \begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}}
    & ({{\mathsf{label}}_{n}}{\{ {{\mathit{instr}}^\ast} \}}~{{\mathit{val}}^\ast}) & \hookrightarrow & {{\mathit{val}}^\ast} \\
    \end{array}\end{split}

Note

This semantics also applies to the instruction sequence contained in a `\mathsf{loop}` instruction. Therefore, execution of a loop falls off the end, unless a backwards branch is performed explicitly.

## Exception Handling

The following auxiliary rules define the semantics of entering and exiting `\mathsf{try\_table}` blocks.

### Entering `\mathit{instr}^\ast` with label `L` and exception handler `H`

1.  Push `H` to the stack.

2.  Push `L` onto the stack.

3.  Jump to the start of the instruction sequence `\mathit{instr}^\ast`.

Note

No formal reduction rule is needed for entering an exception handler because it is an administrative instruction that the `\mathsf{try\_table}` instruction reduces to directly.

### Exiting an exception handler

When the end of a `\mathsf{try\_table}` block is reached without a jump, exception, or trap, then the following steps are performed.

1.  Let `m` be the number of values on the top of the stack.

2.  Pop the values `\mathit{val}^m` from the stack.

3.  Assert: due to validation, a handler and a label are now on the top of the stack.

4.  Pop the label from the stack.

5.  Pop the handler `H` from the stack.

6.  Push `\mathit{val}^m` back to the stack.

7.  Jump to the position after the end of the administrative instruction associated with the handler `H`.

    \begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}}
    & ({{\mathsf{handler}}_{n}}{\{ {{\mathit{catch}}^\ast} \}}~{{\mathit{val}}^\ast}) & \hookrightarrow & {{\mathit{val}}^\ast} \\
    \end{array}\end{split}

## Function Calls

The following auxiliary rules define the semantics of invoking a function instance through one of the call instructions and returning from it.

### Invocation of function reference `(\mathsf{ref{.}func}~a)`

1.  Assert: due to validation, `S.\mathsf{funcs}[a]` exists.

2.  Let `f` be the function instance, `S.\mathsf{funcs}[a]`.

3.  Let `\mathsf{func}~[t_1^n] \rightarrow [t_2^m]` be the composite type `\mathrm{expand}(\mathit{f}.\mathsf{type})`.

4.  Let `\mathsf{func}~x~\mathit{local}^\ast~\mathit{instr}^\ast` be the function `f.\mathsf{code}`.

5.  Assert: due to validation, `n` values are on the top of the stack.

6.  Pop the values `\mathit{val}^n` from the stack.

7.  Let `F` be the frame `\{ \mathsf{module}~F.\mathsf{module}, \mathsf{locals}~\mathit{val}^n~(\mathrm{default}_t)^\ast \}`.

8.  Push the activation of `f` with arity `m` to the stack.

9.  Let `L` be the label whose arity is `m` and whose continuation is the end of the function.

10. Enter the instruction sequence `\mathit{instr}^\ast` with label `L` and no values.

    \begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}}
    & z ; {{\mathit{val}}^{n}}~(\mathsf{ref{.}func}~a)~(\mathsf{call\_ref}~y) & \hookrightarrow & ({{\mathsf{frame}}_{m}}{\{ f \}}~({{\mathsf{label}}_{m}}{\{ \epsilon \}}~{{\mathit{instr}}^\ast})) &  \\
    &&& \multicolumn{2}{@{}l@{}}{\quad
    \quad
    \begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}}
    \mbox{if}~ z{.}\mathsf{funcs}{}[a] = {\mathit{fi}} \\
    {\land}~ {\mathit{fi}}{.}\mathsf{type} \mathrel{\approx} \mathsf{func}~{t_1^{n}} \rightarrow {t_2^{m}} \\
    {\land}~ {\mathit{fi}}{.}\mathsf{code} = \mathsf{func}~x~{(\mathsf{local}~t)^\ast}~({{\mathit{instr}}^\ast}) \\
    {\land}~ f = \{ \mathsf{locals}~{{\mathit{val}}^{n}}~{({{\mathrm{default}}}_{t})^\ast},\;\allowbreak \mathsf{module}~{\mathit{fi}}{.}\mathsf{module} \} \\
    \end{array}
    } \\
    \end{array}\end{split}

Note

For non-defaultable types, the respective local is left uninitialized by these rules.

### Returning from a function

When the end of a function is reached without a jump (including through `\mathsf{return}`), or an exception or trap aborting it, then the following steps are performed.

1.  Let `F` be the current frame.

2.  Let `n` be the arity of the activation of `F`.

3.  Assert: due to validation, there are `n` values on the top of the stack.

4.  Pop the results `\mathit{val}^n` from the stack.

5.  Assert: due to validation, the frame `F` is now on the top of the stack.

6.  Pop the frame from the stack.

7.  Push `\mathit{val}^n` back to the stack.

8.  Jump to the instruction after the original call.

    \begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}}
    & ({{\mathsf{frame}}_{n}}{\{ f \}}~{{\mathit{val}}^{n}}) & \hookrightarrow & {{\mathit{val}}^{n}} \\
    \end{array}\end{split}

### Host Functions

Invoking a host function has non-deterministic behavior. It may either terminate with a trap, an exception, or return regularly. However, in the latter case, it must consume and produce the right number and types of WebAssembly values on the stack, according to its function type.

A host function may also modify the store. However, all store modifications must result in an extension of the original store, i.e., they must only modify mutable contents and must not have instances removed. Furthermore, the resulting store must be valid, i.e., all data and code in it is well-typed.

    \begin{split}~\\[-1ex]
    \begin{array}{l}
    \begin{array}{lcl@{\qquad}l}
    S; \mathit{val}^n~(\mathsf{ref{.}func}~a)~\mathsf{call\_ref} &\hookrightarrow& S'; \mathit{result}
    \end{array}
    \\ \qquad
    \begin{array}[t]{@{}r@{~}l@{}}
    \mathrel{\mbox{if}} & S.\mathsf{funcs}[a] = \{ \mathsf{type}~\mathit{deftype}, \mathsf{hostfunc}~\mathit{hf} \} \\
    \wedge & \mathit{deftype} \approx \mathsf{func}~[t_1^n] \rightarrow [t_2^m] \\
    \wedge & (S'; \mathit{result}) \in \mathit{hf}(S; \mathit{val}^n) \\
    \end{array} \\
    \begin{array}{lcl@{\qquad}l}
    S; \mathit{val}^n~(\mathsf{ref{.}func}~a)~\mathsf{call\_ref} &\hookrightarrow& S; \mathit{val}^n~(\mathsf{ref{.}func}~a)~\mathsf{call\_ref}
    \end{array}
    \\ \qquad
    \begin{array}[t]{@{}r@{~}l@{}}
    \mathrel{\mbox{if}} & S.\mathsf{funcs}[a] = \{ \mathsf{type}~\mathit{deftype}, \mathsf{hostfunc}~\mathit{hf} \} \\
    \wedge & \mathit{deftype} \approx \mathsf{func}~[t_1^n] \rightarrow [t_2^m] \\
    \wedge & \bot \in \mathit{hf}(S; \mathit{val}^n) \\
    \end{array} \\
    \end{array}\end{split}

Here, `\mathit{hf}(S; \mathit{val}^n)` denotes the implementation-defined execution of host function `\mathit{hf}` in current store `S` with arguments `\mathit{val}^n`. It yields a set of possible outcomes, where each element is either a pair of a modified store `S'` and a result or the special value `\bot` indicating divergence. A host function is non-deterministic if there is at least one argument for which the set of outcomes is not singular.

For a WebAssembly implementation to be sound in the presence of host functions, every host function instance must be valid, which means that it adheres to suitable pre- and post-conditions: under a valid store `S`, and given arguments `\mathit{val}^n` matching the ascribed parameter types `t_1^n`, executing the host function must yield a non-empty set of possible outcomes each of which is either divergence or consists of a valid store `S'` that is an extension of `S` and a result matching the ascribed return types `t_2^m`. All these notions are made precise in the Appendix.

Note

A host function can call back into WebAssembly by invoking a function exported from a module. However, the effects of any such call are subsumed by the non-deterministic behavior allowed for the host function.

## Variable Instructions

### `\mathsf{local{.}get}~x`

1.  Let `z` be the current state.

2.  Assert: Due to validation, `z{.}\mathsf{locals}{}[x]` is defined.

3.  Let `{\mathit{val}}` be `z{.}\mathsf{locals}{}[x]`.

4.  Push the value `{\mathit{val}}` to the stack.

    \begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}}
    & z ; (\mathsf{local{.}get}~x) & \hookrightarrow & {\mathit{val}} & \quad \mbox{if}~ z{.}\mathsf{locals}{}[x] = {\mathit{val}} \\
    \end{array}\end{split}

### `\mathsf{local{.}set}~x`

1.  Let `z` be the current state.

2.  Assert: Due to validation, a value is on the top of the stack.

3.  Pop the value `{\mathit{val}}` from the stack.

4.  Replace `z{.}\mathsf{locals}{}[x]` with `{\mathit{val}}`.

    \begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}}
    & z ; {\mathit{val}}~(\mathsf{local{.}set}~x) & \hookrightarrow & z{}[{.}\mathsf{locals}{}[x] = {\mathit{val}}] ; \epsilon \\
    \end{array}\end{split}

### `\mathsf{local{.}tee}~x`

1.  Assert: Due to validation, a value is on the top of the stack.

2.  Pop the value `{\mathit{val}}` from the stack.

3.  Push the value `{\mathit{val}}` to the stack.

4.  Push the value `{\mathit{val}}` to the stack.

5.  Execute the instruction `(\mathsf{local{.}set}~x)`.

    \begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}}
    & {\mathit{val}}~(\mathsf{local{.}tee}~x) & \hookrightarrow & {\mathit{val}}~{\mathit{val}}~(\mathsf{local{.}set}~x) \\
    \end{array}\end{split}

### `\mathsf{global{.}get}~x`

1.  Let `z` be the current state.

2.  Let `{\mathit{val}}` be the value `z{.}\mathsf{globals}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{value}`.

3.  Push the value `{\mathit{val}}` to the stack.

    \begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}}
    & z ; (\mathsf{global{.}get}~x) & \hookrightarrow & {\mathit{val}} & \quad \mbox{if}~ z{.}\mathsf{globals}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{value} = {\mathit{val}} \\
    \end{array}\end{split}

### `\mathsf{global{.}set}~x`

1.  Let `z` be the current state.

2.  Assert: Due to validation, a value is on the top of the stack.

3.  Pop the value `{\mathit{val}}` from the stack.

4.  Replace `z{.}\mathsf{globals}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{value}` with `{\mathit{val}}`.

    \begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}}
    & z ; {\mathit{val}}~(\mathsf{global{.}set}~x) & \hookrightarrow & z{}[{.}\mathsf{globals}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{value} = {\mathit{val}}] ; \epsilon \\
    \end{array}\end{split}

## Table Instructions

### `\mathsf{table{.}get}~x`

1.  Let `z` be the current state.

2.  Assert: Due to validation, a number value is on the top of the stack.

3.  Pop the value `({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)` from the stack.

4.  If `i \geq {|z{.}\mathsf{tables}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{refs}|}`, then:

    1.  Trap.

5.  Push the value `z{.}\mathsf{tables}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{refs}{}[i]` to the stack.

    \begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}}
    & z ; ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)~(\mathsf{table{.}get}~x) & \hookrightarrow & \mathsf{trap} & \quad \mbox{if}~ i \geq {|z{.}\mathsf{tables}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{refs}|} \\
    & z ; ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)~(\mathsf{table{.}get}~x) & \hookrightarrow & z{.}\mathsf{tables}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{refs}{}[i] & \quad \mbox{if}~ i < {|z{.}\mathsf{tables}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{refs}|} \\
    \end{array}\end{split}

### `\mathsf{table{.}set}~x`

1.  Let `z` be the current state.

2.  Assert: Due to validation, a reference value is on the top of the stack.

3.  Pop the value `{\mathit{ref}}` from the stack.

4.  Assert: Due to validation, a number value is on the top of the stack.

5.  Pop the value `({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)` from the stack.

6.  If `i \geq {|z{.}\mathsf{tables}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{refs}|}`, then:

    1.  Trap.

7.  Replace `z{.}\mathsf{tables}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{refs}{}[i]` with `{\mathit{ref}}`.

    \begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}}
    & z ; ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)~{\mathit{ref}}~(\mathsf{table{.}set}~x) & \hookrightarrow & z ; \mathsf{trap} & \quad \mbox{if}~ i \geq {|z{.}\mathsf{tables}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{refs}|} \\
    & z ; ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)~{\mathit{ref}}~(\mathsf{table{.}set}~x) & \hookrightarrow & z{}[{.}\mathsf{tables}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{refs}{}[i] = {\mathit{ref}}] ; \epsilon & \quad \mbox{if}~ i < {|z{.}\mathsf{tables}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{refs}|} \\
    \end{array}\end{split}

### `\mathsf{table{.}size}~x`

1.  Let `z` be the current state.

2.  Let `({\mathit{at}}~{\mathit{lim}}~{\mathit{rt}})` be the destructuring of `z{.}\mathsf{tables}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{type}`.

3.  Let `n` be the length of `z{.}\mathsf{tables}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{refs}`.

4.  Push the value `({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~n)` to the stack.

    \begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}}
    & z ; (\mathsf{table{.}size}~x) & \hookrightarrow & ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~n) & \quad
    \begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}}
    \mbox{if}~ {|z{.}\mathsf{tables}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{refs}|} = n \\
    {\land}~ z{.}\mathsf{tables}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{type} = {\mathit{at}}~{\mathit{lim}}~{\mathit{rt}} \\
    \end{array} \\
    \end{array}\end{split}

### `\mathsf{table{.}grow}~x`

1.  Let `z` be the current state.

2.  Assert: Due to validation, a number value is on the top of the stack.

3.  Pop the value `({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~n)` from the stack.

4.  Assert: Due to validation, a reference value is on the top of the stack.

5.  Pop the value `{\mathit{ref}}` from the stack.

6.  Either:

    1.  Let `{\mathit{ti}}` be the table instance `{\mathrm{growtable}}(z{.}\mathsf{tables}{}[x], n, {\mathit{ref}})`.

    2.  Push the value `({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~{|z{.}\mathsf{tables}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{refs}|})` to the stack.

    3.  Replace `z{.}\mathsf{tables}{}[x]` with `{\mathit{ti}}`.

7.  Or:

    1.  Push the value `({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~{{{{\mathrm{signed}}}_{{|{\mathit{at}}|}}^{{-1}}}}{({-1})})` to the stack.

    \begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}}
    & z ; {\mathit{ref}}~({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~n)~(\mathsf{table{.}grow}~x) & \hookrightarrow & z{}[{.}\mathsf{tables}{}[x] = {\mathit{ti}}] ; ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~{|z{.}\mathsf{tables}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{refs}|}) &  \\
    &&& \multicolumn{2}{@{}l@{}}{\quad
    \quad \mbox{if}~ {\mathit{ti}} = {\mathrm{growtable}}(z{.}\mathsf{tables}{}[x], n, {\mathit{ref}})
    } \\
    & z ; {\mathit{ref}}~({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~n)~(\mathsf{table{.}grow}~x) & \hookrightarrow & z ; ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~{{{{\mathrm{signed}}}_{{|{\mathit{at}}|}}^{{-1}}}}{({-1})}) \\
    \end{array}\end{split}

Note

The `\mathsf{table{.}grow}` instruction is non-deterministic. It may either succeed, returning the old table size `\mathit{sz}`, or fail, returning `{-1}`. Failure *must* occur if the referenced table instance has a maximum size defined that would be exceeded. However, failure *can* occur in other cases as well. In practice, the choice depends on the resources available to the embedder.

### `\mathsf{table{.}fill}~x`

1.  Let `z` be the current state.

2.  Assert: Due to validation, a number value is on the top of the stack.

3.  Pop the value `({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~n)` from the stack.

4.  Assert: Due to validation, a value is on the top of the stack.

5.  Pop the value `{\mathit{val}}` from the stack.

6.  Assert: Due to validation, a value of number type `{\mathit{at}}` is on the top of the stack.

7.  Pop the value `({\mathit{numtype}}_0{.}\mathsf{const}~i)` from the stack.

8.  If `i + n > {|z{.}\mathsf{tables}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{refs}|}`, then:

    1.  Trap.

9.  If `n = 0`, then:

    1.  Do nothing.

10. Else:

    1.  Push the value `({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)` to the stack.

    2.  Push the value `{\mathit{val}}` to the stack.

    3.  Execute the instruction `(\mathsf{table{.}set}~x)`.

    4.  Push the value `({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i + 1)` to the stack.

    5.  Push the value `{\mathit{val}}` to the stack.

    6.  Push the value `({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~n - 1)` to the stack.

    7.  Execute the instruction `(\mathsf{table{.}fill}~x)`.

    \begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}}
    & z ; ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)~{\mathit{val}}~({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~n)~(\mathsf{table{.}fill}~x) & \hookrightarrow & \mathsf{trap} & \quad \mbox{if}~ i + n > {|z{.}\mathsf{tables}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{refs}|} \\
    & z ; ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)~{\mathit{val}}~({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~n)~(\mathsf{table{.}fill}~x) & \hookrightarrow & \epsilon & \quad \mbox{otherwise, if}~ n = 0 \\
    & z ; ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)~{\mathit{val}}~({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~n)~(\mathsf{table{.}fill}~x) & \hookrightarrow & & \\
    & \multicolumn{4}{@{}l@{}}{\quad
    \begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}l@{}}
    \begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}} ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)~{\mathit{val}}~(\mathsf{table{.}set}~x) \\
    ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i + 1)~{\mathit{val}}~({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~n - 1)~(\mathsf{table{.}fill}~x) \end{array} & \quad \mbox{otherwise} \\
    \end{array}
    } \\
    \end{array}\end{split}

### `\mathsf{table{.}copy}~x_1~x_2`

1.  Let `z` be the current state.

2.  Assert: Due to validation, a number value is on the top of the stack.

3.  Pop the value `({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~n)` from the stack.

4.  Assert: Due to validation, a number value is on the top of the stack.

5.  Pop the value `({\mathit{at}}_2{.}\mathsf{const}~i_2)` from the stack.

6.  Assert: Due to validation, a number value is on the top of the stack.

7.  Pop the value `({\mathit{at}}_1{.}\mathsf{const}~i_1)` from the stack.

8.  If `i_1 + n > {|z{.}\mathsf{tables}{}[x_1]{.}\mathsf{refs}|}`, then:

    1.  Trap.

9.  If `i_2 + n > {|z{.}\mathsf{tables}{}[x_2]{.}\mathsf{refs}|}`, then:

    1.  Trap.

10. If `n = 0`, then:

    1.  Do nothing.

11. Else:

    1.  If `i_1 \leq i_2`, then:

        1.  Push the value `({\mathit{at}}_1{.}\mathsf{const}~i_1)` to the stack.

        2.  Push the value `({\mathit{at}}_2{.}\mathsf{const}~i_2)` to the stack.

        3.  Execute the instruction `(\mathsf{table{.}get}~x_2)`.

        4.  Execute the instruction `(\mathsf{table{.}set}~x_1)`.

        5.  Push the value `({\mathit{at}}_1{.}\mathsf{const}~i_1 + 1)` to the stack.

        6.  Push the value `({\mathit{at}}_2{.}\mathsf{const}~i_2 + 1)` to the stack.

    2.  Else:

        1.  Push the value `({\mathit{at}}_1{.}\mathsf{const}~i_1 + n - 1)` to the stack.

        2.  Push the value `({\mathit{at}}_2{.}\mathsf{const}~i_2 + n - 1)` to the stack.

        3.  Execute the instruction `(\mathsf{table{.}get}~x_2)`.

        4.  Execute the instruction `(\mathsf{table{.}set}~x_1)`.

        5.  Push the value `({\mathit{at}}_1{.}\mathsf{const}~i_1)` to the stack.

        6.  Push the value `({\mathit{at}}_2{.}\mathsf{const}~i_2)` to the stack.

    3.  Push the value `({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~n - 1)` to the stack.

    4.  Execute the instruction `(\mathsf{table{.}copy}~x_1~x_2)`.

    \begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}}
    & z ; ({\mathit{at}}_1{.}\mathsf{const}~i_1)~({\mathit{at}}_2{.}\mathsf{const}~i_2)~({\mathit{at}'}{.}\mathsf{const}~n)~(\mathsf{table{.}copy}~x_1~x_2) & \hookrightarrow & \mathsf{trap} &  \\
    & \multicolumn{4}{@{}l@{}}{\quad
    \quad \mbox{if}~ i_1 + n > {|z{.}\mathsf{tables}{}[x_1]{.}\mathsf{refs}|} \lor i_2 + n > {|z{.}\mathsf{tables}{}[x_2]{.}\mathsf{refs}|}
    } \\
    & z ; ({\mathit{at}}_1{.}\mathsf{const}~i_1)~({\mathit{at}}_2{.}\mathsf{const}~i_2)~({\mathit{at}'}{.}\mathsf{const}~n)~(\mathsf{table{.}copy}~x~y) & \hookrightarrow & \epsilon & \quad \mbox{otherwise, if}~ n = 0 \\
    & z ; ({\mathit{at}}_1{.}\mathsf{const}~i_1)~({\mathit{at}}_2{.}\mathsf{const}~i_2)~({\mathit{at}'}{.}\mathsf{const}~n)~(\mathsf{table{.}copy}~x~y) & \hookrightarrow & & \\
    & \multicolumn{4}{@{}l@{}}{\quad
    \begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}l@{}}
    \begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}} ({\mathit{at}}_1{.}\mathsf{const}~i_1)~({\mathit{at}}_2{.}\mathsf{const}~i_2)~(\mathsf{table{.}get}~y)~(\mathsf{table{.}set}~x) \\
    ({\mathit{at}}_1{.}\mathsf{const}~i_1 + 1)~({\mathit{at}}_2{.}\mathsf{const}~i_2 + 1)~({\mathit{at}'}{.}\mathsf{const}~n - 1)~(\mathsf{table{.}copy}~x~y) \end{array} & \quad \mbox{otherwise, if}~ i_1 \leq i_2 \\
    \end{array}
    } \\
    & z ; ({\mathit{at}}_1{.}\mathsf{const}~i_1)~({\mathit{at}}_2{.}\mathsf{const}~i_2)~({\mathit{at}'}{.}\mathsf{const}~n)~(\mathsf{table{.}copy}~x~y) & \hookrightarrow & & \\
    & \multicolumn{4}{@{}l@{}}{\quad
    \begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}l@{}}
    \begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}} ({\mathit{at}}_1{.}\mathsf{const}~i_1 + n - 1)~({\mathit{at}}_2{.}\mathsf{const}~i_2 + n - 1)~(\mathsf{table{.}get}~y)~(\mathsf{table{.}set}~x) \\
    ({\mathit{at}}_1{.}\mathsf{const}~i_1)~({\mathit{at}}_2{.}\mathsf{const}~i_2)~({\mathit{at}'}{.}\mathsf{const}~n - 1)~(\mathsf{table{.}copy}~x~y) \end{array} & \quad \mbox{otherwise} \\
    \end{array}
    } \\
    \end{array}\end{split}

### `\mathsf{table{.}init}~x~y`

1.  Let `z` be the current state.

2.  Assert: Due to validation, a value of number type `\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}` is on the top of the stack.

3.  Pop the value `(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~n)` from the stack.

4.  Assert: Due to validation, a value of number type `\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}` is on the top of the stack.

5.  Pop the value `(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~j)` from the stack.

6.  Assert: Due to validation, a number value is on the top of the stack.

7.  Pop the value `({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)` from the stack.

8.  If `i + n > {|z{.}\mathsf{tables}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{refs}|}`, then:

    1.  Trap.

9.  If `j + n > {|z{.}\mathsf{elems}{}[y]{.}\mathsf{refs}|}`, then:

    1.  Trap.

10. If `n = 0`, then:

    1.  Do nothing.

11. Else:

    1.  Assert: Due to validation, `j < {|z{.}\mathsf{elems}{}[y]{.}\mathsf{refs}|}`.

    2.  Push the value `({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)` to the stack.

    3.  Push the value `z{.}\mathsf{elems}{}[y]{.}\mathsf{refs}{}[j]` to the stack.

    4.  Execute the instruction `(\mathsf{table{.}set}~x)`.

    5.  Push the value `({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i + 1)` to the stack.

    6.  Push the value `(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~j + 1)` to the stack.

    7.  Push the value `(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~n - 1)` to the stack.

    8.  Execute the instruction `(\mathsf{table{.}init}~x~y)`.

    \begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}}
    & z ; ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~j)~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~n)~(\mathsf{table{.}init}~x~y) & \hookrightarrow & \mathsf{trap} &  \\
    & \multicolumn{4}{@{}l@{}}{\quad
    \quad \mbox{if}~ i + n > {|z{.}\mathsf{tables}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{refs}|} \lor j + n > {|z{.}\mathsf{elems}{}[y]{.}\mathsf{refs}|}
    } \\
    & z ; ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~j)~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~n)~(\mathsf{table{.}init}~x~y) & \hookrightarrow & \epsilon & \quad \mbox{otherwise, if}~ n = 0 \\
    & z ; ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~j)~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~n)~(\mathsf{table{.}init}~x~y) & \hookrightarrow & & \\
    & \multicolumn{4}{@{}l@{}}{\quad
    \begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}l@{}}
    \begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}} ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)~z{.}\mathsf{elems}{}[y]{.}\mathsf{refs}{}[j]~(\mathsf{table{.}set}~x) \\
    ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i + 1)~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~j + 1)~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~n - 1)~(\mathsf{table{.}init}~x~y) \end{array} & \quad \mbox{otherwise} \\
    \end{array}
    } \\
    \end{array}\end{split}

### `\mathsf{elem{.}drop}~x`

1.  Let `z` be the current state.

2.  Replace `z{.}\mathsf{elems}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{refs}` with `\epsilon`.

    \begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}}
    & z ; (\mathsf{elem{.}drop}~x) & \hookrightarrow & z{}[{.}\mathsf{elems}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{refs} = \epsilon] ; \epsilon \\
    \end{array}\end{split}

## Memory Instructions

Note

The alignment `\mathit{memarg}.\mathsf{align}` in load and store instructions does not affect the semantics. It is a hint that the offset `\mathit{ea}` at which the memory is accessed is intended to satisfy the property `\mathit{ea} \mathbin{\mathrm{mod}} 2^{\mathit{memarg}.\mathsf{align}} = 0`. A WebAssembly implementation can use this hint to optimize for the intended use. Unaligned access violating that property is still allowed and must succeed regardless of the annotation. However, it may be substantially slower on some hardware.

### `{{\mathit{nt}}{.}\mathsf{load}}{{{\mathit{loadop}}^?}}~x~{\mathit{ao}}`

1.  Let `z` be the current state.

2.  Assert: Due to validation, a number value is on the top of the stack.

3.  Pop the value `({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)` from the stack.

4.  If `{{\mathit{loadop}}^?}` is not defined, then:

    1.  If `i + {\mathit{ao}}{.}\mathsf{offset} + {|{\mathit{nt}}|} / 8 > {|z{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{bytes}|}`, then:

        1.  Trap.

    2.  Let `c` be the result for which `{{\mathrm{bytes}}}_{{\mathit{nt}}}(c)` `=` `z{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{bytes}{}[i + {\mathit{ao}}{.}\mathsf{offset} : {|{\mathit{nt}}|} / 8]`.

    3.  Push the value `({\mathit{nt}}{.}\mathsf{const}~c)` to the stack.

5.  Else:

    1.  Assert: Due to validation, `{\mathit{nt}}` is `{\mathsf{i}}{{\scriptstyle\kern-0.1emN}}`.

    2.  Let `{\mathit{loadop}}_0` be `{{\mathit{loadop}}^?}`.

    3.  Let `{n}{\mathsf{\_}}{{\mathit{sx}}}` be the destructuring of `{\mathit{loadop}}_0`.

    4.  If `i + {\mathit{ao}}{.}\mathsf{offset} + n / 8 > {|z{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{bytes}|}`, then:

        1.  Trap.

    5.  Let `c` be the result for which `{{\mathrm{bytes}}}_{{\mathsf{i}}{n}}(c)` `=` `z{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{bytes}{}[i + {\mathit{ao}}{.}\mathsf{offset} : n / 8]`.

    6.  Push the value `({\mathit{nt}}{.}\mathsf{const}~{{{{\mathrm{extend}}}_{n, {|{\mathit{nt}}|}}^{{\mathit{sx}}}}}{(c)})` to the stack.

    \begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}}
    & z ; ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)~({\mathit{nt}}{.}\mathsf{load}~x~{\mathit{ao}}) & \hookrightarrow & \mathsf{trap} &  \\
    &&& \multicolumn{2}{@{}l@{}}{\quad
    \quad \mbox{if}~ i + {\mathit{ao}}{.}\mathsf{offset} + {|{\mathit{nt}}|} / 8 > {|z{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{bytes}|}
    } \\
    & z ; ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)~({\mathit{nt}}{.}\mathsf{load}~x~{\mathit{ao}}) & \hookrightarrow & ({\mathit{nt}}{.}\mathsf{const}~c) &  \\
    &&& \multicolumn{2}{@{}l@{}}{\quad
    \quad \mbox{if}~ {{\mathrm{bytes}}}_{{\mathit{nt}}}(c) = z{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{bytes}{}[i + {\mathit{ao}}{.}\mathsf{offset} : {|{\mathit{nt}}|} / 8]
    } \\
    & z ; ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)~({{\mathsf{i}}{{\scriptstyle\kern-0.1emN}}{.}\mathsf{load}}{{n}{\mathsf{\_}}{{\mathit{sx}}}}~x~{\mathit{ao}}) & \hookrightarrow & \mathsf{trap} &  \\
    &&& \multicolumn{2}{@{}l@{}}{\quad
    \quad \mbox{if}~ i + {\mathit{ao}}{.}\mathsf{offset} + n / 8 > {|z{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{bytes}|}
    } \\
    & z ; ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)~({{\mathsf{i}}{{\scriptstyle\kern-0.1emN}}{.}\mathsf{load}}{{n}{\mathsf{\_}}{{\mathit{sx}}}}~x~{\mathit{ao}}) & \hookrightarrow & ({\mathsf{i}}{{\scriptstyle\kern-0.1emN}}{.}\mathsf{const}~{{{{\mathrm{extend}}}_{n, {|{\mathsf{i}}{{\scriptstyle\kern-0.1emN}}|}}^{{\mathit{sx}}}}}{(c)}) &  \\
    &&& \multicolumn{2}{@{}l@{}}{\quad
    \quad \mbox{if}~ {{\mathrm{bytes}}}_{{\mathsf{i}}{n}}(c) = z{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{bytes}{}[i + {\mathit{ao}}{.}\mathsf{offset} : n / 8]
    } \\
    \end{array}\end{split}

### `{\mathsf{v\scriptstyle128}{.}\mathsf{load}}{{K}{\mathsf{x}}{M}{\mathsf{\_}}{{\mathit{sx}}}}~x~{\mathit{ao}}`

1.  Let `z` be the current state.

2.  Assert: Due to validation, a number value is on the top of the stack.

3.  Pop the value `({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)` from the stack.

4.  If `i + {\mathit{ao}}{.}\mathsf{offset} + K \cdot M / 8 > {|z{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{bytes}|}`, then:

    1.  Trap.

5.  Let `{j^{M}}` be the result for which `{({{\mathrm{bytes}}}_{{\mathsf{i}}{K}}({j^{M}}) = z{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{bytes}{}[i + {\mathit{ao}}{.}\mathsf{offset} + k \cdot K / 8 : K / 8])^{k<M}}`.

6.  Let `{\mathsf{i}}{{\scriptstyle\kern-0.1emN}}` be the result for which `N` `=` `K \cdot 2`.

7.  Let `c` be `{{{{\mathrm{lanes}}}_{{{\mathsf{i}}{{\scriptstyle\kern-0.1emN}}}{\mathsf{x}}{M}}^{{-1}}}}{({{{{{\mathrm{extend}}}_{K, N}^{{\mathit{sx}}}}}{(j)}^{M}})}`.

8.  Push the value `(\mathsf{v\scriptstyle128}{.}\mathsf{const}~c)` to the stack.

    \begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}}
    & z ; ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)~({\mathsf{v\scriptstyle128}{.}\mathsf{load}}{{K}{\mathsf{x}}{M}{\mathsf{\_}}{{\mathit{sx}}}}~x~{\mathit{ao}}) & \hookrightarrow & \mathsf{trap} & \quad \mbox{if}~ i + {\mathit{ao}}{.}\mathsf{offset} + K \cdot M / 8 > {|z{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{bytes}|} \\
    & z ; ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)~({\mathsf{v\scriptstyle128}{.}\mathsf{load}}{{K}{\mathsf{x}}{M}{\mathsf{\_}}{{\mathit{sx}}}}~x~{\mathit{ao}}) & \hookrightarrow & (\mathsf{v\scriptstyle128}{.}\mathsf{const}~c) &  \\
    & \multicolumn{4}{@{}l@{}}{\quad
    \quad
    \begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}}
    \mbox{if}~ ({{\mathrm{bytes}}}_{{\mathsf{i}}{K}}(j) = z{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{bytes}{}[i + {\mathit{ao}}{.}\mathsf{offset} + k \cdot K / 8 : K / 8])^{k<M} \\
    {\land}~ c = {{{{\mathrm{lanes}}}_{{{\mathsf{i}}{{\scriptstyle\kern-0.1emN}}}{\mathsf{x}}{M}}^{{-1}}}}{({{{{{\mathrm{extend}}}_{K, N}^{{\mathit{sx}}}}}{(j)}^{M}})} \land N = K \cdot 2 \\
    \end{array}
    } \\
    \end{array}\end{split}

### `{\mathsf{v\scriptstyle128}{.}\mathsf{load}}{{N}{\mathsf{\_}}{\mathsf{splat}}}~x~{\mathit{ao}}`

1.  Let `z` be the current state.

2.  Assert: Due to validation, a number value is on the top of the stack.

3.  Pop the value `({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)` from the stack.

4.  If `i + {\mathit{ao}}{.}\mathsf{offset} + N / 8 > {|z{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{bytes}|}`, then:

    1.  Trap.

5.  Let `M` be `128 / N`.

6.  Let `{\mathsf{i}}{{\scriptstyle\kern-0.1emN}}` be the result for which `{|{\mathsf{i}}{{\scriptstyle\kern-0.1emN}}|}` `=` `N`.

7.  Let `j` be the result for which `{{\mathrm{bytes}}}_{{\mathsf{i}}{N}}(j)` `=` `z{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{bytes}{}[i + {\mathit{ao}}{.}\mathsf{offset} : N / 8]`.

8.  Let `c` be `{{{{\mathrm{lanes}}}_{{{\mathsf{i}}{{\scriptstyle\kern-0.1emN}}}{\mathsf{x}}{M}}^{{-1}}}}{({j^{M}})}`.

9.  Push the value `(\mathsf{v\scriptstyle128}{.}\mathsf{const}~c)` to the stack.

    \begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}}
    & z ; ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)~({\mathsf{v\scriptstyle128}{.}\mathsf{load}}{{N}{\mathsf{\_}}{\mathsf{splat}}}~x~{\mathit{ao}}) & \hookrightarrow & \mathsf{trap} & \quad \mbox{if}~ i + {\mathit{ao}}{.}\mathsf{offset} + N / 8 > {|z{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{bytes}|} \\
    & z ; ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)~({\mathsf{v\scriptstyle128}{.}\mathsf{load}}{{N}{\mathsf{\_}}{\mathsf{splat}}}~x~{\mathit{ao}}) & \hookrightarrow & (\mathsf{v\scriptstyle128}{.}\mathsf{const}~c) &  \\
    &&& \multicolumn{2}{@{}l@{}}{\quad
    \quad
    \begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}}
    \mbox{if}~ {{\mathrm{bytes}}}_{{\mathsf{i}}{N}}(j) = z{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{bytes}{}[i + {\mathit{ao}}{.}\mathsf{offset} : N / 8] \\
    {\land}~ N = {|{\mathsf{i}}{{\scriptstyle\kern-0.1emN}}|} \\
    {\land}~ M = 128 / N \\
    {\land}~ c = {{{{\mathrm{lanes}}}_{{{\mathsf{i}}{{\scriptstyle\kern-0.1emN}}}{\mathsf{x}}{M}}^{{-1}}}}{({j^{M}})} \\
    \end{array}
    } \\
    \end{array}\end{split}

### `{\mathsf{v\scriptstyle128}{.}\mathsf{load}}{{N}{\mathsf{\_}}{\mathsf{zero}}}~x~{\mathit{ao}}`

1.  Let `z` be the current state.

2.  Assert: Due to validation, a number value is on the top of the stack.

3.  Pop the value `({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)` from the stack.

4.  If `i + {\mathit{ao}}{.}\mathsf{offset} + N / 8 > {|z{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{bytes}|}`, then:

    1.  Trap.

5.  Let `j` be the result for which `{{\mathrm{bytes}}}_{{\mathsf{i}}{N}}(j)` `=` `z{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{bytes}{}[i + {\mathit{ao}}{.}\mathsf{offset} : N / 8]`.

6.  Let `c` be `{{{{\mathrm{extend}}}_{N, 128}^{\mathsf{u}}}}{(j)}`.

7.  Push the value `(\mathsf{v\scriptstyle128}{.}\mathsf{const}~c)` to the stack.

    \begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}}
    & z ; ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)~({\mathsf{v\scriptstyle128}{.}\mathsf{load}}{{N}{\mathsf{\_}}{\mathsf{zero}}}~x~{\mathit{ao}}) & \hookrightarrow & \mathsf{trap} & \quad \mbox{if}~ i + {\mathit{ao}}{.}\mathsf{offset} + N / 8 > {|z{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{bytes}|} \\
    & z ; ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)~({\mathsf{v\scriptstyle128}{.}\mathsf{load}}{{N}{\mathsf{\_}}{\mathsf{zero}}}~x~{\mathit{ao}}) & \hookrightarrow & (\mathsf{v\scriptstyle128}{.}\mathsf{const}~c) &  \\
    &&& \multicolumn{2}{@{}l@{}}{\quad
    \quad
    \begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}}
    \mbox{if}~ {{\mathrm{bytes}}}_{{\mathsf{i}}{N}}(j) = z{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{bytes}{}[i + {\mathit{ao}}{.}\mathsf{offset} : N / 8] \\
    {\land}~ c = {{{{\mathrm{extend}}}_{N, 128}^{\mathsf{u}}}}{(j)} \\
    \end{array}
    } \\
    \end{array}\end{split}

### `{\mathsf{v\scriptstyle128}{.}\mathsf{load}}{N}{\mathsf{\_}}{\mathsf{lane}}~x~{\mathit{ao}}~j`

1.  Let `z` be the current state.

2.  Assert: Due to validation, a value of vector type `\mathsf{v\scriptstyle128}` is on the top of the stack.

3.  Pop the value `(\mathsf{v\scriptstyle128}{.}\mathsf{const}~c_1)` from the stack.

4.  Assert: Due to validation, a number value is on the top of the stack.

5.  Pop the value `({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)` from the stack.

6.  If `i + {\mathit{ao}}{.}\mathsf{offset} + N / 8 > {|z{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{bytes}|}`, then:

    1.  Trap.

7.  Let `M` be `{|\mathsf{v\scriptstyle128}|} / N`.

8.  Let `{\mathsf{i}}{{\scriptstyle\kern-0.1emN}}` be the result for which `{|{\mathsf{i}}{{\scriptstyle\kern-0.1emN}}|}` `=` `N`.

9.  Let `k` be the result for which `{{\mathrm{bytes}}}_{{\mathsf{i}}{N}}(k)` `=` `z{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{bytes}{}[i + {\mathit{ao}}{.}\mathsf{offset} : N / 8]`.

10. Let `c` be `{{{{\mathrm{lanes}}}_{{{\mathsf{i}}{{\scriptstyle\kern-0.1emN}}}{\mathsf{x}}{M}}^{{-1}}}}{({{\mathrm{lanes}}}_{{{\mathsf{i}}{{\scriptstyle\kern-0.1emN}}}{\mathsf{x}}{M}}(c_1){}[{}[j] = k])}`.

11. Push the value `(\mathsf{v\scriptstyle128}{.}\mathsf{const}~c)` to the stack.

    \begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}}
    & z ; ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)~(\mathsf{v\scriptstyle128}{.}\mathsf{const}~c_1)~({\mathsf{v\scriptstyle128}{.}\mathsf{load}}{N}{\mathsf{\_}}{\mathsf{lane}}~x~{\mathit{ao}}~j) & \hookrightarrow & \mathsf{trap} & \quad \mbox{if}~ i + {\mathit{ao}}{.}\mathsf{offset} + N / 8 > {|z{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{bytes}|} \\
    & z ; ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)~(\mathsf{v\scriptstyle128}{.}\mathsf{const}~c_1)~({\mathsf{v\scriptstyle128}{.}\mathsf{load}}{N}{\mathsf{\_}}{\mathsf{lane}}~x~{\mathit{ao}}~j) & \hookrightarrow & (\mathsf{v\scriptstyle128}{.}\mathsf{const}~c) &  \\
    &&& \multicolumn{2}{@{}l@{}}{\quad
    \quad
    \begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}}
    \mbox{if}~ {{\mathrm{bytes}}}_{{\mathsf{i}}{N}}(k) = z{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{bytes}{}[i + {\mathit{ao}}{.}\mathsf{offset} : N / 8] \\
    {\land}~ N = {|{\mathsf{i}}{{\scriptstyle\kern-0.1emN}}|} \\
    {\land}~ M = {|\mathsf{v\scriptstyle128}|} / N \\
    {\land}~ c = {{{{\mathrm{lanes}}}_{{{\mathsf{i}}{{\scriptstyle\kern-0.1emN}}}{\mathsf{x}}{M}}^{{-1}}}}{({{\mathrm{lanes}}}_{{{\mathsf{i}}{{\scriptstyle\kern-0.1emN}}}{\mathsf{x}}{M}}(c_1){}[{}[j] = k])} \\
    \end{array}
    } \\
    \end{array}\end{split}

### `{{\mathit{nt}}{.}\mathsf{store}}{{{\mathit{storeop}}^?}}~x~{\mathit{ao}}`

1.  Let `z` be the current state.

2.  Assert: Due to validation, a number value is on the top of the stack.

3.  Pop the value `({\mathit{nt}'}{.}\mathsf{const}~c)` from the stack.

4.  Assert: Due to validation, a value is on the top of the stack.

5.  Pop the value `({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)` from the stack.

6.  Assert: Due to validation, `{\mathit{nt}} = {\mathit{nt}'}`.

7.  If `{{\mathit{storeop}}^?}` is not defined, then:

    1.  If `i + {\mathit{ao}}{.}\mathsf{offset} + {|{\mathit{nt}'}|} / 8 > {|z{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{bytes}|}`, then:

        1.  Trap.

    2.  Let `{b^\ast}` be `{{\mathrm{bytes}}}_{{\mathit{nt}'}}(c)`.

    3.  Replace `z{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{bytes}{}[i + {\mathit{ao}}{.}\mathsf{offset} : {|{\mathit{nt}'}|} / 8]` with `{b^\ast}`.

8.  Else:

    1.  Assert: Due to validation, `{\mathit{nt}'}` is `{\mathsf{i}}{{\scriptstyle\kern-0.1emN}}`.

    2.  Let `n` be `{{\mathit{storeop}}^?}`.

    3.  If `i + {\mathit{ao}}{.}\mathsf{offset} + n / 8 > {|z{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{bytes}|}`, then:

        1.  Trap.

    4.  Let `{b^\ast}` be `{{\mathrm{bytes}}}_{{\mathsf{i}}{n}}({{\mathrm{wrap}}}_{{|{\mathit{nt}'}|}, n}(c))`.

    5.  Replace `z{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{bytes}{}[i + {\mathit{ao}}{.}\mathsf{offset} : n / 8]` with `{b^\ast}`.

    \begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}}
    & z ; ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)~({\mathit{nt}}{.}\mathsf{const}~c)~({\mathit{nt}}{.}\mathsf{store}~x~{\mathit{ao}}) & \hookrightarrow & z ; \mathsf{trap} &  \\
    &&& \multicolumn{2}{@{}l@{}}{\quad
    \quad \mbox{if}~ i + {\mathit{ao}}{.}\mathsf{offset} + {|{\mathit{nt}}|} / 8 > {|z{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{bytes}|}
    } \\
    & z ; ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)~({\mathit{nt}}{.}\mathsf{const}~c)~({\mathit{nt}}{.}\mathsf{store}~x~{\mathit{ao}}) & \hookrightarrow & z{}[{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{bytes}{}[i + {\mathit{ao}}{.}\mathsf{offset} : {|{\mathit{nt}}|} / 8] = {b^\ast}] ; \epsilon &  \\
    &&& \multicolumn{2}{@{}l@{}}{\quad
    \quad \mbox{if}~ {b^\ast} = {{\mathrm{bytes}}}_{{\mathit{nt}}}(c)
    } \\
    & z ; ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)~({\mathsf{i}}{{\scriptstyle\kern-0.1emN}}{.}\mathsf{const}~c)~({{\mathsf{i}}{{\scriptstyle\kern-0.1emN}}{.}\mathsf{store}}{n}~x~{\mathit{ao}}) & \hookrightarrow & z ; \mathsf{trap} &  \\
    &&& \multicolumn{2}{@{}l@{}}{\quad
    \quad \mbox{if}~ i + {\mathit{ao}}{.}\mathsf{offset} + n / 8 > {|z{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{bytes}|}
    } \\
    & z ; ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)~({\mathsf{i}}{{\scriptstyle\kern-0.1emN}}{.}\mathsf{const}~c)~({{\mathsf{i}}{{\scriptstyle\kern-0.1emN}}{.}\mathsf{store}}{n}~x~{\mathit{ao}}) & \hookrightarrow & z{}[{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{bytes}{}[i + {\mathit{ao}}{.}\mathsf{offset} : n / 8] = {b^\ast}] ; \epsilon &  \\
    &&& \multicolumn{2}{@{}l@{}}{\quad
    \quad \mbox{if}~ {b^\ast} = {{\mathrm{bytes}}}_{{\mathsf{i}}{n}}({{\mathrm{wrap}}}_{{|{\mathsf{i}}{{\scriptstyle\kern-0.1emN}}|}, n}(c))
    } \\
    & z ; ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)~(\mathsf{v\scriptstyle128}{.}\mathsf{const}~c)~(\mathsf{v\scriptstyle128}{.}\mathsf{store}~x~{\mathit{ao}}) & \hookrightarrow & z ; \mathsf{trap} &  \\
    &&& \multicolumn{2}{@{}l@{}}{\quad
    \quad \mbox{if}~ i + {\mathit{ao}}{.}\mathsf{offset} + {|\mathsf{v\scriptstyle128}|} / 8 > {|z{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{bytes}|}
    } \\
    & z ; ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)~(\mathsf{v\scriptstyle128}{.}\mathsf{const}~c)~(\mathsf{v\scriptstyle128}{.}\mathsf{store}~x~{\mathit{ao}}) & \hookrightarrow & z{}[{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{bytes}{}[i + {\mathit{ao}}{.}\mathsf{offset} : {|\mathsf{v\scriptstyle128}|} / 8] = {b^\ast}] ; \epsilon &  \\
    &&& \multicolumn{2}{@{}l@{}}{\quad
    \quad \mbox{if}~ {b^\ast} = {{\mathrm{bytes}}}_{\mathsf{v\scriptstyle128}}(c)
    } \\
    \end{array}\end{split}

### `{\mathsf{v\scriptstyle128}{.}\mathsf{store}}{N}{\mathsf{\_}}{\mathsf{lane}}~x~{\mathit{ao}}~j`

1.  Let `z` be the current state.

2.  Assert: Due to validation, a value of vector type `\mathsf{v\scriptstyle128}` is on the top of the stack.

3.  Pop the value `(\mathsf{v\scriptstyle128}{.}\mathsf{const}~c)` from the stack.

4.  Assert: Due to validation, a number value is on the top of the stack.

5.  Pop the value `({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)` from the stack.

6.  If `i + {\mathit{ao}}{.}\mathsf{offset} + N > {|z{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{bytes}|}`, then:

    1.  Trap.

7.  Let `M` be `128 / N`.

8.  Let `{\mathsf{i}}{{\scriptstyle\kern-0.1emN}}` be the result for which `{|{\mathsf{i}}{{\scriptstyle\kern-0.1emN}}|}` `=` `N`.

9.  Assert: Due to validation, `j < {|{{\mathrm{lanes}}}_{{{\mathsf{i}}{{\scriptstyle\kern-0.1emN}}}{\mathsf{x}}{M}}(c)|}`.

10. Let `{b^\ast}` be `{{\mathrm{bytes}}}_{{\mathsf{i}}{N}}({{\mathrm{lanes}}}_{{{\mathsf{i}}{{\scriptstyle\kern-0.1emN}}}{\mathsf{x}}{M}}(c){}[j])`.

11. Replace `z{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{bytes}{}[i + {\mathit{ao}}{.}\mathsf{offset} : N / 8]` with `{b^\ast}`.

    \begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}}
    & z ; ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)~(\mathsf{v\scriptstyle128}{.}\mathsf{const}~c)~({\mathsf{v\scriptstyle128}{.}\mathsf{store}}{N}{\mathsf{\_}}{\mathsf{lane}}~x~{\mathit{ao}}~j) & \hookrightarrow & z ; \mathsf{trap} &  \\
    &&& \multicolumn{2}{@{}l@{}}{\quad
    \quad \mbox{if}~ i + {\mathit{ao}}{.}\mathsf{offset} + N > {|z{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{bytes}|}
    } \\
    & z ; ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)~(\mathsf{v\scriptstyle128}{.}\mathsf{const}~c)~({\mathsf{v\scriptstyle128}{.}\mathsf{store}}{N}{\mathsf{\_}}{\mathsf{lane}}~x~{\mathit{ao}}~j) & \hookrightarrow & z{}[{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{bytes}{}[i + {\mathit{ao}}{.}\mathsf{offset} : N / 8] = {b^\ast}] ; \epsilon &  \\
    &&& \multicolumn{2}{@{}l@{}}{\quad
    \quad
    \begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}}
    \mbox{if}~ N = {|{\mathsf{i}}{{\scriptstyle\kern-0.1emN}}|} \\
    {\land}~ M = 128 / N \\
    {\land}~ {b^\ast} = {{\mathrm{bytes}}}_{{\mathsf{i}}{N}}({{\mathrm{lanes}}}_{{{\mathsf{i}}{{\scriptstyle\kern-0.1emN}}}{\mathsf{x}}{M}}(c){}[j]) \\
    \end{array}
    } \\
    \end{array}\end{split}

### `\mathsf{memory{.}size}~x`

1.  Let `z` be the current state.

2.  Let `({\mathit{at}}~{\mathit{lim}}~\mathsf{page})` be the destructuring of `z{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{type}`.

3.  Let `n \cdot 64 \, {\mathrm{Ki}}` be the length of `z{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{bytes}`.

4.  Push the value `({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~n)` to the stack.

    \begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}}
    & z ; (\mathsf{memory{.}size}~x) & \hookrightarrow & ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~n) & \quad
    \begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}}
    \mbox{if}~ n \cdot 64 \, {\mathrm{Ki}} = {|z{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{bytes}|} \\
    {\land}~ z{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{type} = {\mathit{at}}~{\mathit{lim}}~\mathsf{page} \\
    \end{array} \\
    \end{array}\end{split}

### `\mathsf{memory{.}grow}~x`

1.  Let `z` be the current state.

2.  Assert: Due to validation, a number value is on the top of the stack.

3.  Pop the value `({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~n)` from the stack.

4.  Either:

    1.  Let `{\mathit{mi}}` be the memory instance `{\mathrm{growmem}}(z{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x], n)`.

    2.  Push the value `({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~{|z{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{bytes}|} / (64 \, {\mathrm{Ki}}))` to the stack.

    3.  Replace `z{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x]` with `{\mathit{mi}}`.

5.  Or:

    1.  Push the value `({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~{{{{\mathrm{signed}}}_{{|{\mathit{at}}|}}^{{-1}}}}{({-1})})` to the stack.

    \begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}}
    & z ; ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~n)~(\mathsf{memory{.}grow}~x) & \hookrightarrow & z{}[{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x] = {\mathit{mi}}] ; ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~{|z{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{bytes}|} / 64 \, {\mathrm{Ki}}) &  \\
    &&& \multicolumn{2}{@{}l@{}}{\quad
    \quad \mbox{if}~ {\mathit{mi}} = {\mathrm{growmem}}(z{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x], n)
    } \\
    & z ; ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~n)~(\mathsf{memory{.}grow}~x) & \hookrightarrow & z ; ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~{{{{\mathrm{signed}}}_{{|{\mathit{at}}|}}^{{-1}}}}{({-1})}) \\
    \end{array}\end{split}

Note

The `\mathsf{memory{.}grow}` instruction is non-deterministic. It may either succeed, returning the old memory size `\mathit{sz}`, or fail, returning `{-1}`. Failure *must* occur if the referenced memory instance has a maximum size defined that would be exceeded. However, failure *can* occur in other cases as well. In practice, the choice depends on the resources available to the embedder.

### `\mathsf{memory{.}fill}~x`

1.  Let `z` be the current state.

2.  Assert: Due to validation, a number value is on the top of the stack.

3.  Pop the value `({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~n)` from the stack.

4.  Assert: Due to validation, a value is on the top of the stack.

5.  Pop the value `{\mathit{val}}` from the stack.

6.  Assert: Due to validation, a value of number type `{\mathit{at}}` is on the top of the stack.

7.  Pop the value `({\mathit{numtype}}_0{.}\mathsf{const}~i)` from the stack.

8.  If `i + n > {|z{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{bytes}|}`, then:

    1.  Trap.

9.  If `n = 0`, then:

    1.  Do nothing.

10. Else:

    1.  Push the value `({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)` to the stack.

    2.  Push the value `{\mathit{val}}` to the stack.

    3.  Execute the instruction `({\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{store}}{8}~x)`.

    4.  Push the value `({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i + 1)` to the stack.

    5.  Push the value `{\mathit{val}}` to the stack.

    6.  Push the value `({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~n - 1)` to the stack.

    7.  Execute the instruction `(\mathsf{memory{.}fill}~x)`.

    \begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}}
    & z ; ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)~{\mathit{val}}~({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~n)~(\mathsf{memory{.}fill}~x) & \hookrightarrow & \mathsf{trap} & \quad \mbox{if}~ i + n > {|z{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{bytes}|} \\
    & z ; ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)~{\mathit{val}}~({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~n)~(\mathsf{memory{.}fill}~x) & \hookrightarrow & \epsilon & \quad \mbox{otherwise, if}~ n = 0 \\
    & z ; ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)~{\mathit{val}}~({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~n)~(\mathsf{memory{.}fill}~x) & \hookrightarrow & & \\
    & \multicolumn{4}{@{}l@{}}{\quad
    \begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}l@{}}
    \begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}} ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)~{\mathit{val}}~({\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{store}}{\mathsf{{\scriptstyle 8}}}~x) \\
    ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i + 1)~{\mathit{val}}~({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~n - 1)~(\mathsf{memory{.}fill}~x) \end{array} & \quad \mbox{otherwise} \\
    \end{array}
    } \\
    \end{array}\end{split}

### `\mathsf{memory{.}copy}~x_1~x_2`

1.  Let `z` be the current state.

2.  Assert: Due to validation, a number value is on the top of the stack.

3.  Pop the value `({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~n)` from the stack.

4.  Assert: Due to validation, a number value is on the top of the stack.

5.  Pop the value `({\mathit{at}}_2{.}\mathsf{const}~i_2)` from the stack.

6.  Assert: Due to validation, a number value is on the top of the stack.

7.  Pop the value `({\mathit{at}}_1{.}\mathsf{const}~i_1)` from the stack.

8.  If `i_1 + n > {|z{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x_1]{.}\mathsf{bytes}|}`, then:

    1.  Trap.

9.  If `i_2 + n > {|z{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x_2]{.}\mathsf{bytes}|}`, then:

    1.  Trap.

10. If `n = 0`, then:

    1.  Do nothing.

11. Else:

    1.  If `i_1 \leq i_2`, then:

        1.  Push the value `({\mathit{at}}_1{.}\mathsf{const}~i_1)` to the stack.

        2.  Push the value `({\mathit{at}}_2{.}\mathsf{const}~i_2)` to the stack.

        3.  Execute the instruction `({\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{load}}{{8}{\mathsf{\_}}{\mathsf{u}}}~x_2)`.

        4.  Execute the instruction `({\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{store}}{8}~x_1)`.

        5.  Push the value `({\mathit{at}}_1{.}\mathsf{const}~i_1 + 1)` to the stack.

        6.  Push the value `({\mathit{at}}_2{.}\mathsf{const}~i_2 + 1)` to the stack.

    2.  Else:

        1.  Push the value `({\mathit{at}}_1{.}\mathsf{const}~i_1 + n - 1)` to the stack.

        2.  Push the value `({\mathit{at}}_2{.}\mathsf{const}~i_2 + n - 1)` to the stack.

        3.  Execute the instruction `({\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{load}}{{8}{\mathsf{\_}}{\mathsf{u}}}~x_2)`.

        4.  Execute the instruction `({\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{store}}{8}~x_1)`.

        5.  Push the value `({\mathit{at}}_1{.}\mathsf{const}~i_1)` to the stack.

        6.  Push the value `({\mathit{at}}_2{.}\mathsf{const}~i_2)` to the stack.

    3.  Push the value `({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~n - 1)` to the stack.

    4.  Execute the instruction `(\mathsf{memory{.}copy}~x_1~x_2)`.

    \begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}}
    & z ; ({\mathit{at}}_1{.}\mathsf{const}~i_1)~({\mathit{at}}_2{.}\mathsf{const}~i_2)~({\mathit{at}'}{.}\mathsf{const}~n)~(\mathsf{memory{.}copy}~x_1~x_2) & \hookrightarrow & \mathsf{trap} &  \\
    & \multicolumn{4}{@{}l@{}}{\quad
    \quad \mbox{if}~ i_1 + n > {|z{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x_1]{.}\mathsf{bytes}|} \lor i_2 + n > {|z{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x_2]{.}\mathsf{bytes}|}
    } \\
    & z ; ({\mathit{at}}_1{.}\mathsf{const}~i_1)~({\mathit{at}}_2{.}\mathsf{const}~i_2)~({\mathit{at}'}{.}\mathsf{const}~n)~(\mathsf{memory{.}copy}~x_1~x_2) & \hookrightarrow & \epsilon & \quad \mbox{otherwise, if}~ n = 0 \\
    & z ; ({\mathit{at}}_1{.}\mathsf{const}~i_1)~({\mathit{at}}_2{.}\mathsf{const}~i_2)~({\mathit{at}'}{.}\mathsf{const}~n)~(\mathsf{memory{.}copy}~x_1~x_2) & \hookrightarrow & & \\
    & \multicolumn{4}{@{}l@{}}{\quad
    \begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}l@{}}
    \begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}} ({\mathit{at}}_1{.}\mathsf{const}~i_1)~({\mathit{at}}_2{.}\mathsf{const}~i_2)~({\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{load}}{{\mathsf{{\scriptstyle 8}}}{\mathsf{\_}}{\mathsf{u}}}~x_2)~({\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{store}}{\mathsf{{\scriptstyle 8}}}~x_1) \\
    ({\mathit{at}}_1{.}\mathsf{const}~i_1 + 1)~({\mathit{at}}_2{.}\mathsf{const}~i_2 + 1)~({\mathit{at}'}{.}\mathsf{const}~n - 1)~(\mathsf{memory{.}copy}~x_1~x_2) \end{array} & \quad \mbox{otherwise, if}~ i_1 \leq i_2 \\
    \end{array}
    } \\
    & z ; ({\mathit{at}}_1{.}\mathsf{const}~i_1)~({\mathit{at}}_2{.}\mathsf{const}~i_2)~({\mathit{at}'}{.}\mathsf{const}~n)~(\mathsf{memory{.}copy}~x_1~x_2) & \hookrightarrow & & \\
    & \multicolumn{4}{@{}l@{}}{\quad
    \begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}l@{}}
    \begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}} ({\mathit{at}}_1{.}\mathsf{const}~i_1 + n - 1)~({\mathit{at}}_2{.}\mathsf{const}~i_2 + n - 1)~({\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{load}}{{\mathsf{{\scriptstyle 8}}}{\mathsf{\_}}{\mathsf{u}}}~x_2)~({\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{store}}{\mathsf{{\scriptstyle 8}}}~x_1) \\
    ({\mathit{at}}_1{.}\mathsf{const}~i_1)~({\mathit{at}}_2{.}\mathsf{const}~i_2)~({\mathit{at}'}{.}\mathsf{const}~n - 1)~(\mathsf{memory{.}copy}~x_1~x_2) \end{array} & \quad \mbox{otherwise} \\
    \end{array}
    } \\
    \end{array}\end{split}

### `\mathsf{memory{.}init}~x~y`

1.  Let `z` be the current state.

2.  Assert: Due to validation, a value of number type `\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}` is on the top of the stack.

3.  Pop the value `(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~n)` from the stack.

4.  Assert: Due to validation, a value of number type `\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}` is on the top of the stack.

5.  Pop the value `(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~j)` from the stack.

6.  Assert: Due to validation, a number value is on the top of the stack.

7.  Pop the value `({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)` from the stack.

8.  If `i + n > {|z{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{bytes}|}`, then:

    1.  Trap.

9.  If `j + n > {|z{.}\mathsf{datas}{}[y]{.}\mathsf{bytes}|}`, then:

    1.  Trap.

10. If `n = 0`, then:

    1.  Do nothing.

11. Else:

    1.  Assert: Due to validation, `j < {|z{.}\mathsf{datas}{}[y]{.}\mathsf{bytes}|}`.

    2.  Push the value `({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)` to the stack.

    3.  Push the value `(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~z{.}\mathsf{datas}{}[y]{.}\mathsf{bytes}{}[j])` to the stack.

    4.  Execute the instruction `({\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{store}}{8}~x)`.

    5.  Push the value `({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i + 1)` to the stack.

    6.  Push the value `(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~j + 1)` to the stack.

    7.  Push the value `(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~n - 1)` to the stack.

    8.  Execute the instruction `(\mathsf{memory{.}init}~x~y)`.

    \begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}}
    & z ; ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~j)~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~n)~(\mathsf{memory{.}init}~x~y) & \hookrightarrow & \mathsf{trap} &  \\
    & \multicolumn{4}{@{}l@{}}{\quad
    \quad \mbox{if}~ i + n > {|z{.}\mathsf{mems}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{bytes}|} \lor j + n > {|z{.}\mathsf{datas}{}[y]{.}\mathsf{bytes}|}
    } \\
    & z ; ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~j)~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~n)~(\mathsf{memory{.}init}~x~y) & \hookrightarrow & \epsilon & \quad \mbox{otherwise, if}~ n = 0 \\
    & z ; ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~j)~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~n)~(\mathsf{memory{.}init}~x~y) & \hookrightarrow & & \\
    & \multicolumn{4}{@{}l@{}}{\quad
    \begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}l@{}}
    \begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}} ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~z{.}\mathsf{datas}{}[y]{.}\mathsf{bytes}{}[j])~({\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{store}}{\mathsf{{\scriptstyle 8}}}~x) \\
    ({\mathit{at}}{.}\mathsf{const}~i + 1)~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~j + 1)~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~n - 1)~(\mathsf{memory{.}init}~x~y) \end{array} & \quad \mbox{otherwise} \\
    \end{array}
    } \\
    \end{array}\end{split}

### `\mathsf{data{.}drop}~x`

1.  Let `z` be the current state.

2.  Replace `z{.}\mathsf{datas}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{bytes}` with `\epsilon`.

    \begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}}
    & z ; (\mathsf{data{.}drop}~x) & \hookrightarrow & z{}[{.}\mathsf{datas}{}[x]{.}\mathsf{bytes} = \epsilon] ; \epsilon \\
    \end{array}\end{split}

## Reference Instructions

### `\mathsf{ref{.}null}~{\mathit{ht}}`

1.  Push the value `\mathsf{ref{.}null}` to the stack.

    \begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}}
    & z ; (\mathsf{ref{.}null}~{\mathit{ht}}) & \hookrightarrow & \mathsf{ref{.}null} \\
    \end{array}\end{split}

### `\mathsf{ref{.}func}~x`

1.  Let `z` be the current state.

2.  Assert: Due to validation, `x < {|z{.}\mathsf{module}{.}\mathsf{funcs}|}`.

3.  Push the value `(\mathsf{ref{.}func}~z{.}\mathsf{module}{.}\mathsf{funcs}{}[x])` to the stack.

    \begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}}
    & z ; (\mathsf{ref{.}func}~x) & \hookrightarrow & (\mathsf{ref{.}func}~z{.}\mathsf{module}{.}\mathsf{funcs}{}[x]) \\
    \end{array}\end{split}

### `\mathsf{ref{.}is\_null}`

1.  Assert: Due to validation, a reference value is on the top of the stack.

2.  Pop the value `{\mathit{ref}}` from the stack.

3.  If `{\mathit{ref}} = \mathsf{ref{.}null}`, then:

    1.  Push the value `(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~1)` to the stack.

4.  Else:

    1.  Push the value `(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~0)` to the stack.

    \begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}}
    & {\mathit{ref}}~\mathsf{ref{.}is\_null} & \hookrightarrow & (\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~1) & \quad \mbox{if}~ {\mathit{ref}} = \mathsf{ref{.}null} \\
    & {\mathit{ref}}~\mathsf{ref{.}is\_null} & \hookrightarrow & (\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~0) & \quad \mbox{otherwise} \\
    \end{array}\end{split}

### `\mathsf{ref{.}as\_non\_null}`

1.  Assert: Due to validation, a reference value is on the top of the stack.

2.  Pop the value `{\mathit{ref}}` from the stack.

3.  If `{\mathit{ref}} = \mathsf{ref{.}null}`, then:

    1.  Trap.

4.  Push the value `{\mathit{ref}}` to the stack.

    \begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}}
    & {\mathit{ref}}~\mathsf{ref{.}as\_non\_null} & \hookrightarrow & \mathsf{trap} & \quad \mbox{if}~ {\mathit{ref}} = \mathsf{ref{.}null} \\
    & {\mathit{ref}}~\mathsf{ref{.}as\_non\_null} & \hookrightarrow & {\mathit{ref}} & \quad \mbox{otherwise} \\
    \end{array}\end{split}

### `\mathsf{ref{.}eq}`

1.  Assert: Due to validation, a reference value is on the top of the stack.

2.  Pop the value `{\mathit{ref}}_2` from the stack.

3.  Assert: Due to validation, a reference value is on the top of the stack.

4.  Pop the value `{\mathit{ref}}_1` from the stack.

5.  If `{\mathit{ref}}_1 = \mathsf{ref{.}null}` and `{\mathit{ref}}_2 = \mathsf{ref{.}null}`, then:

    1.  Push the value `(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~1)` to the stack.

6.  Else if `{\mathit{ref}}_1 = {\mathit{ref}}_2`, then:

    1.  Push the value `(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~1)` to the stack.

7.  Else:

    1.  Push the value `(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~0)` to the stack.

    \begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}}
    & {\mathit{ref}}_1~{\mathit{ref}}_2~\mathsf{ref{.}eq} & \hookrightarrow & (\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~1) & \quad \mbox{if}~ {\mathit{ref}}_1 = \mathsf{ref{.}null} \land {\mathit{ref}}_2 = \mathsf{ref{.}null} \\
    & {\mathit{ref}}_1~{\mathit{ref}}_2~\mathsf{ref{.}eq} & \hookrightarrow & (\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~1) & \quad \mbox{otherwise, if}~ {\mathit{ref}}_1 = {\mathit{ref}}_2 \\
    & {\mathit{ref}}_1~{\mathit{ref}}_2~\mathsf{ref{.}eq} & \hookrightarrow & (\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~0) & \quad \mbox{otherwise} \\
    \end{array}\end{split}

### `\mathsf{ref{.}test}~{\mathit{rt}}`

1.  Let `f` be the topmost `\mathsf{frame}`.

2.  Assert: Due to validation, a reference value is on the top of the stack.

3.  Pop the value `{\mathit{ref}}` from the stack.

4.  If `{\mathit{ref}}` is valid with type `{{\mathrm{clos}}}_{f{.}\mathsf{module}}({\mathit{rt}})`, then:

    1.  Push the value `(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~1)` to the stack.

5.  Else:

    1.  Push the value `(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~0)` to the stack.

    \begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}}
    & s ; f ; {\mathit{ref}}~(\mathsf{ref{.}test}~{\mathit{rt}}) & \hookrightarrow & (\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~1) & \quad \mbox{if}~ s \vdash {\mathit{ref}} : {{\mathrm{clos}}}_{f{.}\mathsf{module}}({\mathit{rt}}) \\
    & s ; f ; {\mathit{ref}}~(\mathsf{ref{.}test}~{\mathit{rt}}) & \hookrightarrow & (\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~0) & \quad \mbox{otherwise} \\
    \end{array}\end{split}

### `\mathsf{ref{.}cast}~{\mathit{rt}}`

1.  Let `f` be the topmost `\mathsf{frame}`.

2.  Assert: Due to validation, a reference value is on the top of the stack.

3.  Pop the value `{\mathit{ref}}` from the stack.

4.  If not `{\mathit{ref}}` is valid with type `{{\mathrm{clos}}}_{f{.}\mathsf{module}}({\mathit{rt}})`, then:

    1.  Trap.

5.  Push the value `{\mathit{ref}}` to the stack.

    \begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}}
    & s ; f ; {\mathit{ref}}~(\mathsf{ref{.}cast}~{\mathit{rt}}) & \hookrightarrow & {\mathit{ref}} & \quad \mbox{if}~ s \vdash {\mathit{ref}} : {{\mathrm{clos}}}_{f{.}\mathsf{module}}({\mathit{rt}}) \\
    & s ; f ; {\mathit{ref}}~(\mathsf{ref{.}cast}~{\mathit{rt}}) & \hookrightarrow & \mathsf{trap} & \quad \mbox{otherwise} \\
    \end{array}\end{split}

### `\mathsf{ref{.}i\scriptstyle31}`

1.  Assert: Due to validation, a value of number type `\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}` is on the top of the stack.

2.  Pop the value `(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)` from the stack.

3.  Push the value `(\mathsf{ref{.}i\scriptstyle31}~{{\mathrm{wrap}}}_{32, 31}(i))` to the stack.

    \begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}}
    & (\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)~\mathsf{ref{.}i\scriptstyle31} & \hookrightarrow & (\mathsf{ref{.}i\scriptstyle31}~{{\mathrm{wrap}}}_{32, 31}(i)) \\
    \end{array}\end{split}

### `{\mathsf{i{\scriptstyle31}{.}get}}{\mathsf{\_}}{{\mathit{sx}}}`

1.  Assert: Due to validation, a value is on the top of the stack.

2.  Pop the value `{\mathit{val}}` from the stack.

3.  If `{\mathit{val}} = \mathsf{ref{.}null}`, then:

    1.  Trap.

4.  Assert: Due to validation, `{\mathit{val}}` is some `\mathsf{ref{.}i\scriptstyle31}~{\mathit{u\scriptstyle\kern-0.1em31}}`.

5.  Let `(\mathsf{ref{.}i\scriptstyle31}~i)` be the destructuring of `{\mathit{val}}`.

6.  Push the value `(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~{{{{\mathrm{extend}}}_{31, 32}^{{\mathit{sx}}}}}{(i)})` to the stack.

    \begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}}
    & (\mathsf{ref{.}null})~({\mathsf{i{\scriptstyle31}{.}get}}{\mathsf{\_}}{{\mathit{sx}}}) & \hookrightarrow & \mathsf{trap} \\
    & (\mathsf{ref{.}i\scriptstyle31}~i)~({\mathsf{i{\scriptstyle31}{.}get}}{\mathsf{\_}}{{\mathit{sx}}}) & \hookrightarrow & (\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~{{{{\mathrm{extend}}}_{31, 32}^{{\mathit{sx}}}}}{(i)}) \\
    \end{array}\end{split}

### `\mathsf{struct{.}new}~x`

1.  Let `z` be the current state.

2.  Assert: Due to validation, the expansion of `z{.}\mathsf{types}{}[x]` is some `\mathsf{struct}~{\mathit{list}}({\mathit{fieldtype}})`.

3.  Let `(\mathsf{struct}~{\mathit{list}}_0)` be the destructuring of the expansion of `z{.}\mathsf{types}{}[x]`.

4.  Let `{({\mathsf{mut}^?}~{\mathit{zt}})^{n}}` be `{\mathit{list}}_0`.

5.  Let `a` be the length of `z{.}\mathsf{structs}`.

6.  Assert: Due to validation, there are at least `n` values on the top of the stack.

7.  Pop the values `{{\mathit{val}}^{n}}` from the stack.

8.  Let `{\mathit{si}}` be the structure instance `\{ \mathsf{type}~z{.}\mathsf{types}{}[x],\;\allowbreak \mathsf{fields}~{{{\mathrm{pack}}}_{{\mathit{zt}}}({\mathit{val}})^{n}} \}`.

9.  Push the value `(\mathsf{ref{.}struct}~a)` to the stack.

10. Append `{\mathit{si}}` to `z{.}\mathsf{structs}`.

    \begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}}

    & z ; (\mathsf{ref{.}array}~a)~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)~{\mathit{val}}~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~n)~(\mathsf{array{.}fill}~x) & \hookrightarrow & & \\
    & \multicolumn{4}{@{}l@{}}{\quad
    \begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}l@{}}
    \begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}} (\mathsf{ref{.}array}~a)~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~i)~{\mathit{val}}~(\mathsf{array{.}set}~x) \\
    (\mathsf{ref{.}array}~a)~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~i + 1)~{\mathit{val}}~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~n - 1)~(\mathsf{array{.}fill}~x) \end{array} & \quad \mbox{otherwise} \\
    \end{array}
    } \\
    \end{array}\end{split}

### `\mathsf{array{.}copy}~x_1~x_2`

1.  Let `z` be the current state.

2.  Assert: Due to validation, a value of number type `\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}` is on the top of the stack.

3.  Pop the value `(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~n)` from the stack.

4.  Assert: Due to validation, a value of number type `\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}` is on the top of the stack.

5.  Pop the value `(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~i_2)` from the stack.

6.  Assert: Due to validation, a value is on the top of the stack.

7.  Pop the value `{\mathit{val}}` from the stack.

8.  Assert: Due to validation, a value of number type `\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}` is on the top of the stack.

9.  Pop the value `(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~i_1)` from the stack.

10. Assert: Due to validation, a value is on the top of the stack.

11. Pop the value `{\mathit{val}'}` from the stack.

12. If `{\mathit{val}'} = \mathsf{ref{.}null}` and `{\mathit{val}}` is reference value, then:

    1.  Trap.

13. If `{\mathit{val}} = \mathsf{ref{.}null}` and `{\mathit{val}'}` is reference value, then:

    1.  Trap.

14. If `{\mathit{val}'}` is some `\mathsf{ref{.}array}~{\mathit{arrayaddr}}`, then:

    1.  Let `(\mathsf{ref{.}array}~a_1)` be the destructuring of `{\mathit{val}'}`.

    2.  If `{\mathit{val}}` is some `\mathsf{ref{.}array}~{\mathit{arrayaddr}}`, then:

        1.  If `a_1 < {|z{.}\mathsf{arrays}|}` and `i_1 + n > {|z{.}\mathsf{arrays}{}[a_1]{.}\mathsf{fields}|}`, then:

            1.  Trap.

        2.  Let `(\mathsf{ref{.}array}~a_2)` be the destructuring of `{\mathit{val}}`.

        3.  If `a_2 \geq {|z{.}\mathsf{arrays}|}`, then:

            1.  Do nothing.

        4.  Else if `i_2 + n > {|z{.}\mathsf{arrays}{}[a_2]{.}\mathsf{fields}|}`, then:

            1.  Trap.

        5.  If `n = 0`, then:

            1.  Do nothing.

        6.  Else:

            1.  Assert: Due to validation, the expansion of `z{.}\mathsf{types}{}[x_2]` is some `\mathsf{array}~{\mathit{fieldtype}}`.

            2.  Let `(\mathsf{array}~{\mathit{fieldtype}}_0)` be the destructuring of the expansion of `z{.}\mathsf{types}{}[x_2]`.

            3.  Let `({\mathsf{mut}^?}~{\mathit{zt}}_2)` be the destructuring of `{\mathit{fieldtype}}_0`.

            4.  Let `{{\mathit{sx}}^?}` be `{\mathit{sx}}({\mathit{zt}}_2)`.

            5.  Push the value `(\mathsf{ref{.}array}~a_1)` to the stack.

            6.  If `i_1 \leq i_2`, then:

                1.  Push the value `(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~i_1)` to the stack.

                2.  Push the value `(\mathsf{ref{.}array}~a_2)` to the stack.

                3.  Push the value `(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~i_2)` to the stack.

                4.  Execute the instruction `({\mathsf{array{.}get}}{\mathsf{\_}}{{{\mathit{sx}}^?}}~x_2)`.

                5.  Execute the instruction `(\mathsf{array{.}set}~x_1)`.

                6.  Push the value `(\mathsf{ref{.}array}~a_1)` to the stack.

                7.  Push the value `(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~i_1 + 1)` to the stack.

                8.  Push the value `(\mathsf{ref{.}array}~a_2)` to the stack.

                9.  Push the value `(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~i_2 + 1)` to the stack.

            7.  Else:

                1.  Push the value `(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~i_1 + n - 1)` to the stack.

                2.  Push the value `(\mathsf{ref{.}array}~a_2)` to the stack.

                3.  Push the value `(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~i_2 + n - 1)` to the stack.

                4.  Execute the instruction `({\mathsf{array{.}get}}{\mathsf{\_}}{{{\mathit{sx}}^?}}~x_2)`.

                5.  Execute the instruction `(\mathsf{array{.}set}~x_1)`.

                6.  Push the value `(\mathsf{ref{.}array}~a_1)` to the stack.

                7.  Push the value `(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~i_1)` to the stack.

                8.  Push the value `(\mathsf{ref{.}array}~a_2)` to the stack.

                9.  Push the value `(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~i_2)` to the stack.

            8.  Push the value `(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~n - 1)` to the stack.

            9.  Execute the instruction `(\mathsf{array{.}copy}~x_1~x_2)`.

    \begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}rcl@{}l@{}}
    & z ; (\mathsf{ref{.}null})~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~i_1)~{\mathit{ref}}~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~i_2)~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~n)~(\mathsf{array{.}copy}~x_1~x_2) & \hookrightarrow & \mathsf{trap} \\
    & z ; {\mathit{ref}}~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~i_1)~(\mathsf{ref{.}null})~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~i_2)~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~n)~(\mathsf{array{.}copy}~x_1~x_2) & \hookrightarrow & \mathsf{trap} \\
    & z ; (\mathsf{ref{.}array}~a_1)~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~i_1)~(\mathsf{ref{.}array}~a_2)~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~i_2)~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~n)~(\mathsf{array{.}copy}~x_1~x_2) & \hookrightarrow & \mathsf{trap} &  \\
    & \multicolumn{4}{@{}l@{}}{\quad
    \quad \mbox{if}~ i_1 + n > {|z{.}\mathsf{arrays}{}[a_1]{.}\mathsf{fields}|}
    } \\
    & z ; (\mathsf{ref{.}array}~a_1)~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~i_1)~(\mathsf{ref{.}array}~a_2)~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~i_2)~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~n)~(\mathsf{array{.}copy}~x_1~x_2) & \hookrightarrow & \mathsf{trap} &  \\
    & \multicolumn{4}{@{}l@{}}{\quad
    \quad \mbox{if}~ i_2 + n > {|z{.}\mathsf{arrays}{}[a_2]{.}\mathsf{fields}|}
    } \\
    & z ; (\mathsf{ref{.}array}~a_1)~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~i_1)~(\mathsf{ref{.}array}~a_2)~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~i_2)~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~n)~(\mathsf{array{.}copy}~x_1~x_2) & \hookrightarrow & \epsilon &  \\
    & \multicolumn{4}{@{}l@{}}{\quad
    \quad \mbox{otherwise, if}~ n = 0
    } \\
    & z ; (\mathsf{ref{.}array}~a_1)~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~i_1)~(\mathsf{ref{.}array}~a_2)~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~i_2)~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~n)~(\mathsf{array{.}copy}~x_1~x_2) & \hookrightarrow & & \\
    & \multicolumn{4}{@{}l@{}}{\quad
    \begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}l@{}l@{}}
    \begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}} (\mathsf{ref{.}array}~a_1)~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~i_1) \\
    (\mathsf{ref{.}array}~a_2)~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~i_2) \\
    ({\mathsf{array{.}get}}{\mathsf{\_}}{{{\mathit{sx}}^?}}~x_2)~(\mathsf{array{.}set}~x_1) \\
    (\mathsf{ref{.}array}~a_1)~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~i_1 + 1)~(\mathsf{ref{.}array}~a_2)~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~i_2 + 1)~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~n - 1)~(\mathsf{array{.}copy}~x_1~x_2) \end{array} & & \\
    \multicolumn{3}{@{}l@{}}{\quad
    \begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}}
    \quad
    \begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}}
    \mbox{otherwise, if}~ z{.}\mathsf{types}{}[x_2] \mathrel{\approx} \mathsf{array}~({\mathsf{mut}^?}~{\mathit{zt}}_2) \\
    {\land}~ i_1 \leq i_2 \land {{\mathit{sx}}^?} = {\mathit{sx}}({\mathit{zt}}_2) \\
    \end{array} \\
    \end{array}
    } \\
    \end{array}
    } \\
    & z ; (\mathsf{ref{.}array}~a_1)~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~i_1)~(\mathsf{ref{.}array}~a_2)~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~i_2)~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~n)~(\mathsf{array{.}copy}~x_1~x_2) & \hookrightarrow & & \\
    & \multicolumn{4}{@{}l@{}}{\quad
    \begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}l@{}l@{}}
    \begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}} (\mathsf{ref{.}array}~a_1)~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~i_1 + n - 1) \\
    (\mathsf{ref{.}array}~a_2)~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~i_2 + n - 1) \\
    ({\mathsf{array{.}get}}{\mathsf{\_}}{{{\mathit{sx}}^?}}~x_2)~(\mathsf{array{.}set}~x_1) \\
    (\mathsf{ref{.}array}~a_1)~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~i_1)~(\mathsf{ref{.}array}~a_2)~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~i_2)~(\mathsf{i\scriptstyle32}{.}\mathsf{const}~n - 1)~(\mathsf{array{.}copy}~x_1~x_2) \end{array} & & \\
    \multicolumn{3}{@{}l@{}}{\quad
    \begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}}
    \quad
    \begin{array}[t]{@{}l@{}}
    \mbox{otherwise, if}~ z{.}\mathsf{types}{}[x_2] \mathrel{\approx} \mathsf{array}~({\mathsf{mut}^?}~{\mathit{zt}}_2) \\
    {\land}~ {{\mathit{sx}}^?} = {\mathit{sx}}({\mathit{zt}}_2) \\
    \end{array} \\
    \end{array}
    } \\
    \end{array}
    } \\
    \end{array}\end{split}

Where:

    \begin{split}\begin{array}[t]{@{}lcl@{}l@{}}
    {\mathit{sx}}({\mathit{consttype}}) & = & \epsilon \\
    {\mathit{sx}}({\mathit{packtype}}) & = & \mathsf{s} \\
