## Release 3.0

### Extended Constant Expressions

Allowed basic numeric computations in constant expressions. \[7\]

- Extended set of constant instructions with:

  - `\mathsf{i}\mathit{nn}\mathsf{.add}`

  - `\mathsf{i}\mathit{nn}\mathsf{.sub}`

  - `\mathsf{i}\mathit{nn}\mathsf{.mul}`

  - `\mathsf{global{.}get}` for any previously declared immutable global

Note

The garbage collection extension added further constant instructions.

### Tail Calls

Added instructions to perform tail calls. \[8\]

- New control instructions:

  - `\mathsf{return\_call}`

  - `\mathsf{return\_call\_indirect}`

### Exception Handling

Added tag definitions, imports, and exports, and instructions to throw and catch exceptions. \[9\]

- Modules may

  - define tags

  - import tags

  - export tags

- New heap types:

  - `\mathsf{exn}`

  - `\mathsf{noexn}`

- New reference type short-hands:

  - `\mathsf{exnref}`

  - `\mathsf{nullexnref}`

- New control instructions:

  - `\mathsf{throw}`

  - `\mathsf{throw\_ref}`

  - `\mathsf{try\_table}`

- New tag section in binary format.

### Multiple Memories

Added the ability to use multiple memories per module. \[10\]

- Modules may

  - define multiple memories

  - import multiple memories

  - export multiple memories

- Memory instructions take a memory index immediate:

  - `\mathsf{memory{.}size}`

  - `\mathsf{memory{.}grow}`

  - `\mathsf{memory{.}fill}`

  - `\mathsf{memory{.}copy}`

  - `\mathsf{memory{.}init}`

  - `t\mathsf{.load}`

  - `t\mathsf{.store}`

  - `t\mathsf{.load}\!N\!\mathsf{\_}\mathit{sx}`

  - `t\mathsf{.store}\!N`

  - `\mathsf{v128.load}\!N\!\mathsf{x}\!M\!\mathsf{\_}\mathit{sx}`

  - `\mathsf{v128.load}\!N\!\mathsf{\_zero}`

  - `\mathsf{v128.load}\!N\!\mathsf{\_splat}`

  - `\mathsf{v128.load}\!N\!\mathsf{\_lane}`

  - `\mathsf{v128.store}\!N\!\mathsf{\_lane}`

- Data segments take a memory index

### 64-bit Address Space

Added the ability to declare an `\mathsf{i\scriptstyle64}` address type for tables and memories. \[11\]

- Address types denote a subset of the integral number types

- Table types include an address type

- Memory types include an address type

- Operand types of table and memory instructions now depend on the subject’s declared address type:

  - `\mathsf{table{.}get}`

  - `\mathsf{table{.}set}`

  - `\mathsf{table{.}size}`

  - `\mathsf{table{.}grow}`

  - `\mathsf{table{.}fill}`

  - `\mathsf{table{.}copy}`

  - `\mathsf{table{.}init}`

  - `\mathsf{memory{.}size}`

  - `\mathsf{memory{.}grow}`

  - `\mathsf{memory{.}fill}`

  - `\mathsf{memory{.}copy}`

  - `\mathsf{memory{.}init}`

  - `t\mathsf{.load}`

  - `t\mathsf{.store}`

  - `t\mathsf{.load}\!N\!\mathsf{\_}\mathit{sx}`

  - `t\mathsf{.store}\!N`

  - `\mathsf{v128.load}\!N\!\mathsf{x}\!M\!\mathsf{\_}\mathit{sx}`

  - `\mathsf{v128.load}\!N\!\mathsf{\_zero}`

  - `\mathsf{v128.load}\!N\!\mathsf{\_splat}`

  - `\mathsf{v128.load}\!N\!\mathsf{\_lane}`

  - `\mathsf{v128.store}\!N\!\mathsf{\_lane}`

### Typeful References

Added more precise types for references. \[12\]

- New generalised form of reference types:

  - `(\mathsf{ref}~\mathsf{null}^?~\mathit{heaptype})`

- New class of heap types:

  - `\mathsf{func}`

  - `\mathsf{extern}`

  - `\mathit{typeidx}`

- Basic subtyping on reference and value types

- New reference instructions:

  - `\mathsf{ref{.}as\_non\_null}`

  - `\mathsf{br\_on\_null}`

  - `\mathsf{br\_on\_non\_null}`

- New control instruction:

  - `\mathsf{call\_ref}`

- Refined typing of reference instruction:

  - `\mathsf{ref{.}func}` with more precise result type

- Refined typing of local instructions and instruction sequences to track the initialization status of locals with non-defaultable type

- Refined decoding of active element segments with implicit element type and plain function indices (opcode `0`) to produce non-null reference type

- Extended table definitions with optional initializer expression

### Garbage Collection

Added managed reference types. \[13\]

- New forms of heap types:

  - `\mathsf{any}`

  - `\mathsf{eq}`

  - `\mathsf{i\scriptstyle31}`

  - `\mathsf{struct}`

  - `\mathsf{array}`

  - `\mathsf{none}`

  - `\mathsf{nofunc}`

  - `\mathsf{noextern}`

- New reference type short-hands:

  - `\mathsf{anyref}`

  - `\mathsf{eqref}`

  - `\mathsf{i{\scriptstyle31}ref}`

  - `\mathsf{structref}`

  - `\mathsf{arrayref}`

  - `\mathsf{nullref}`

  - `\mathsf{nullfuncref}`

  - `\mathsf{nullexternref}`

- New forms of type definitions:

  - structure

  - array types

  - sub types

  - recursive types

- Enriched subtyping based on explicitly declared sub types and the new heap types

- New generic reference instructions:

  - `\mathsf{ref{.}eq}`

  - `\mathsf{ref{.}test}`

  - `\mathsf{ref{.}cast}`

  - `\mathsf{br\_on\_cast}`

  - `\mathsf{br\_on\_cast\_fail}`

- New reference instructions for unboxed scalars:

  - `\mathsf{ref{.}i\scriptstyle31}`

  - `\mathsf{i{\scriptstyle31}{.}get}\mathsf{\_}\mathit{sx}`

- New reference instructions for structure types:

  - `\mathsf{struct{.}new}`

  - `\mathsf{struct{.}new\_default}`

  - `\mathsf{struct{.}get}\mathsf{\_}\mathit{sx}^?`

  - `\mathsf{struct{.}set}`

- New reference instructions for array types:

  - `\mathsf{array{.}new}`

  - `\mathsf{array{.}new\_default}`

  - `\mathsf{array{.}new\_fixed}`

  - `\mathsf{array{.}new\_data}`

  - `\mathsf{array{.}new\_elem}`

  - `\mathsf{array{.}get}\mathsf{\_}\mathit{sx}^?`

  - `\mathsf{array{.}set}`

  - `\mathsf{array{.}len}`

  - `\mathsf{array{.}fill}`

  - `\mathsf{array{.}copy}`

  - `\mathsf{array{.}init\_data}`

  - `\mathsf{array{.}init\_elem}`

- New reference instructions for converting external types:

  - `\mathsf{any{.}convert\_extern}`

  - `\mathsf{extern{.}convert\_any}`

- Extended set of constant instructions with:

  - `\mathsf{ref{.}i\scriptstyle31}`

  - `\mathsf{struct{.}new}`

  - `\mathsf{struct{.}new\_default}`

  - `\mathsf{array{.}new}`

  - `\mathsf{array{.}new\_default}`

  - `\mathsf{array{.}new\_fixed}`

  - `\mathsf{any{.}convert\_extern}`

  - `\mathsf{extern{.}convert\_any}`

### Relaxed Vector Instructions

Added new *relaxed* vector instructions, whose behaviour is non-deterministic and implementation-dependent. \[14\]

- New binary vector instruction:

  - `\mathsf{f}\!N\!\mathsf{x}\!M\!\mathsf{.relaxed\_min}`

  - `\mathsf{f}\!N\!\mathsf{x}\!M\!\mathsf{.relaxed\_max}`

  - `\mathsf{i16x8.relaxed\_q15mulr\_s}`

  - `\mathsf{i16x8.relaxed\_dot\_i8x16\_i7x16\_s}`

- New ternary vector instruction:

  - `\mathsf{f}\!N\!\mathsf{x}\!M\!\mathsf{.relaxed\_madd}`

  - `\mathsf{f}\!N\!\mathsf{x}\!M\!\mathsf{.relaxed\_nmadd}`

  - `\mathsf{i}\!N\!\mathsf{x}\!M\!\mathsf{.relaxed\_laneselect}`

  - `\mathsf{i32x4.relaxed\_dot\_i8x16\_i7x16\_add\_s}`

- New conversion vector instructions:

  - `\mathsf{i32x4.relaxed\_trunc\_f32x4\_}\mathit{sx}`

  - `\mathsf{i32x4.relaxed\_trunc\_f64x2\_}\mathit{sx}\mathsf{\_zero}`

- New byte reordering vector instruction:

  - `\mathsf{i8x16.relaxed\_swizzle}`

### Profiles

Introduced the concept of profile for specifying language subsets.

- A new profile defining a deterministic mode of execution.

### Custom Annotations

Added generic syntax for custom annotations in the text format, mirroring the role of custom sections in the binary format. \[15\]

- Annotations of the form `\def\mathdef64#1{\mbox{‘}\mathtt{#1}\mbox{’}}\mathdef64{(@id~\dots)}` are allowed anywhere in the text format

- Identifiers can be escaped as `\def\mathdef65#1{\mbox{‘}\mathtt{#1}\mbox{’}}\mathdef65{@"\dots"}` with arbitrary names

- Defined name annotations `\def\mathdef66#1{\mbox{‘}\mathtt{#1}\mbox{’}}\mathdef66{(@name~"\dots")}` for:

  - module names

  - type names

  - function names

  - local names

  - field names

- Defined custom annotation `\def\mathdef67#1{\mbox{‘}\mathtt{#1}\mbox{’}}\mathdef67{(@custom~"\dots")}` to represent arbitrary custom sections in the text format

# Index of Semantic Rules

## Well-formedness of Types

| Construct        | Judgement                                          |
|------------------|----------------------------------------------------|
| Numeric type     | `C \vdash \mathit{numtype} : \mathsf{ok}`          |
| Vector type      | `C \vdash \mathit{vectype} : \mathsf{ok}`          |
| Heap type        | `C \vdash \mathit{heaptype} : \mathsf{ok}`         |
| Reference type   | `C \vdash \mathit{reftype} : \mathsf{ok}`          |
| Value type       | `C \vdash \mathit{valtype} : \mathsf{ok}`          |
| Packed type      | `C \vdash \mathit{packtype} : \mathsf{ok}`         |
| Storage type     | `C \vdash \mathit{storagetype} : \mathsf{ok}`      |
| Field type       | `C \vdash \mathit{fieldtype} : \mathsf{ok}`        |
| Result type      | `C \vdash \mathit{resulttype} : \mathsf{ok}`       |
| Instruction type | `C \vdash \mathit{instrtype} : \mathsf{ok}`        |
| Composite type   | `C \vdash \mathit{comptype} : \mathsf{ok}`         |
| Sub type         | `C \vdash \mathit{subtype} : \mathsf{ok}`          |
| Recursive type   | `C \vdash \mathit{rectype} : \mathsf{ok}`          |
| Defined type     | `C \vdash \mathit{deftype} : \mathsf{ok}`          |
| Block type       | `C \vdash \mathit{blocktype} : \mathit{instrtype}` |
| Tag type         | `C \vdash \mathit{tagtype} : \mathsf{ok}`          |
| Global type      | `C \vdash \mathit{globaltype} : \mathsf{ok}`       |
| Memory type      | `C \vdash \mathit{memtype} : \mathsf{ok}`          |
| Table type       | `C \vdash \mathit{tabletype} : \mathsf{ok}`        |
| External type    | `C \vdash \mathit{externtype} : \mathsf{ok}`       |
| Type definitions | `C \vdash \mathit{type}^\ast : \mathsf{ok}`        |

## Typing of Static Constructs

| Construct | Judgement |
|----|----|
| Instruction | `S;C \vdash \mathit{instr} : \mathit{instrtype}` |
| Instruction sequence | `S;C \vdash \mathit{instr}^\ast : \mathit{instrtype}` |
| Catch clause | `C \vdash \mathit{catch} : \mathsf{ok}` |
| Expression | `C \vdash \mathit{expr} : \mathit{resulttype}` |
| Limits | `C \vdash \mathit{limits} : k` |
| Tag | `C \vdash \mathit{tag} : \mathit{tagtype}` |
| Global | `C \vdash \mathit{global} : \mathit{globaltype}` |
| Memory | `C \vdash \mathit{mem} : \mathit{memtype}` |
| Table | `C \vdash \mathit{table} : \mathit{tabletype}` |
| Function | `C \vdash \mathit{func} : \mathit{deftype}` |
| Local | `C \vdash \mathit{local} : \mathit{localtype}` |
| Element segment | `C \vdash \mathit{elem} : \mathit{reftype}` |
| Element mode | `C \vdash \mathit{elemmode} : \mathit{reftype}` |
| Data segment | `C \vdash \mathit{data} : \mathsf{ok}` |
| Data mode | `C \vdash \mathit{datamode} : \mathsf{ok}` |
| Start function | `C \vdash \mathit{start} : \mathsf{ok}` |
| Import | `C \vdash \mathit{import} : \mathit{externtype}` |
| Export | `C \vdash \mathit{export} : \mathit{externtype}` |
| Module | `\vdash \mathit{module} : \mathit{externtype}^\ast \rightarrow \mathit{externtype}^\ast` |

## Typing of Runtime Constructs

| Construct | Judgement |
|----|----|
| Value | `S \vdash \mathit{val} : \mathit{valtype}` |
| Result | `S \vdash \mathit{result} : \mathit{resulttype}` |
| Packed value | `S \vdash \mathit{packval} : \mathit{packtype}` |
| Field value | `S \vdash \mathit{fieldval} : \mathit{storagetype}` |
| External address | `S \vdash \mathit{externaddr} : \mathit{externtype}` |
| Tag instance | `S \vdash \mathit{taginst} : \mathit{tagtype}` |
| Global instance | `S \vdash \mathit{globalinst} : \mathit{globaltype}` |
| Memory instance | `S \vdash \mathit{meminst} : \mathit{memtype}` |
| Table instance | `S \vdash \mathit{tableinst} : \mathit{tabletype}` |
| Function instance | `S \vdash \mathit{funcinst} : \mathit{deftype}` |
| Data instance | `S \vdash \mathit{datainst} : \mathsf{ok}` |
| Element instance | `S \vdash \mathit{eleminst} : t` |
| Structure instance | `S \vdash \mathit{structinst} : \mathsf{ok}` |
| Array instance | `S \vdash \mathit{arrayinst} : \mathsf{ok}` |
| Export instance | `S \vdash \mathit{exportinst} : \mathsf{ok}` |
| Module instance | `S \vdash \mathit{moduleinst} : C` |
| Store | `\vdash \mathit{store} : \mathsf{ok}` |
| Configuration | `\vdash \mathit{config} : [t^\ast]` |
| Thread | `S;\mathit{resulttype}^? \vdash \mathit{thread} : \mathit{resulttype}` |
| Frame | `S \vdash \mathit{frame} : C` |

## Constantness

| Construct            | Judgement                                |
|----------------------|------------------------------------------|
| Constant expression  | `C \vdash \mathit{expr} \mathsf{const}`  |
| Constant instruction | `C \vdash \mathit{instr} \mathsf{const}` |

## Matching

| Construct | Judgement |
|----|----|
| Number type | `C \vdash \mathit{numtype}_1 \leq \mathit{numtype}_2` |
| Vector type | `C \vdash \mathit{vectype}_1 \leq \mathit{vectype}_2` |
| Heap type | `C \vdash \mathit{heaptype}_1 \leq \mathit{heaptype}_2` |
| Reference type | `C \vdash \mathit{reftype}_1 \leq \mathit{reftype}_2` |
| Value type | `C \vdash \mathit{valtype}_1 \leq \mathit{valtype}_2` |
| Packed type | `C \vdash \mathit{packtype}_1 \leq \mathit{packtype}_2` |
| Storage type | `C \vdash \mathit{storagetype}_1 \leq \mathit{storagetype}_2` |
| Field type | `C \vdash \mathit{fieldtype}_1 \leq \mathit{fieldtype}_2` |
| Result type | `C \vdash \mathit{resulttype}_1 \leq \mathit{resulttype}_2` |
| Instruction type | `C \vdash \mathit{instrtype}_1 \leq \mathit{instrtype}_2` |
| Composite type | `C \vdash \mathit{comptype}_1 \leq \mathit{comptype}_2` |
| Defined type | `C \vdash \mathit{deftype}_1 \leq \mathit{deftype}_2` |
| Limits | `C \vdash \mathit{limits}_1 \leq \mathit{limits}_2` |
| Tag type | `C \vdash \mathit{tagtype}_1 \leq \mathit{tagtype}_2` |
| Global type | `C \vdash \mathit{globaltype}_1 \leq \mathit{globaltype}_2` |
| Memory type | `C \vdash \mathit{memtype}_1 \leq \mathit{memtype}_2` |
| Table type | `C \vdash \mathit{tabletype}_1 \leq \mathit{tabletype}_2` |
| External type | `C \vdash \mathit{externtype}_1 \leq \mathit{externtype}_2` |

## Store Extension

| Construct | Judgement |
|----|----|
| Tag instance | `\vdash \mathit{taginst}_1 \preceq \mathit{taginst}_2` |
| Global instance | `\vdash \mathit{globalinst}_1 \preceq \mathit{globalinst}_2` |
| Memory instance | `\vdash \mathit{meminst}_1 \preceq \mathit{meminst}_2` |
| Table instance | `\vdash \mathit{tableinst}_1 \preceq \mathit{tableinst}_2` |
| Function instance | `\vdash \mathit{funcinst}_1 \preceq \mathit{funcinst}_2` |
| Data instance | `\vdash \mathit{datainst}_1 \preceq \mathit{datainst}_2` |
| Element instance | `\vdash \mathit{eleminst}_1 \preceq \mathit{eleminst}_2` |
| Structure instance | `\vdash \mathit{structinst}_1 \preceq \mathit{structinst}_2` |
| Array instance | `\vdash \mathit{arrayinst}_1 \preceq \mathit{arrayinst}_2` |
| Store | `\vdash \mathit{store}_1 \preceq \mathit{store}_2` |

## Execution

| Construct | Judgement |
|----|----|
| Instruction | `S;F;\mathit{instr}^\ast \hookrightarrow S';F';{\mathit{instr}'}^\ast` |
| Expression | `S;F;\mathit{expr} \hookrightarrow S';F';\mathit{expr}'` |
